author: Yanko Petrov
preparationDesc:
The lamb is washed well, cleaned of visible fat and cut into small portions. Place in a bowl of cold water and heat over high heat. Before boiling, the broth is carefully skimmed off, then the heat is reduced and the meat is boiled over low heat until tender.

Carrots and white roots are cleaned, washed and cut into small pieces, then added to the meat. When using onions, they are cleaned, finely chopped and added together with the vegetables. The soup is cooked at a gentle simmer, without violent boiling.

When the meat is almost ready, add the pre-washed rice, the chopped tomatoes and the onion. Boiling continues until the rice is completely softened. After removing from the heat, season the soup with fresh parsley and, if necessary, with a minimal amount of salt or a few drops of olive oil. It is served warm.

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: The beans are cleaned and washed, covered with cold water and soaked for 6-8 hours. Washed again, covered with cold water and left to boil on moderate heat together with part of the fat. After boiling, add part of the finely chopped onion and the peppers cut into strips. In the remaining fat and a little water, stew the diced carrots and celery, the rest of the onion, the chopped garlic cloves and some of the finely chopped tomatoes until semi-soft. The beans are poured into a tray and the stewed vegetables are added to it. The dish is salted and mixed, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley, covered with slices of the remaining tomatoes and lemon and baked for 20 minutes in the oven. Sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve after cooling.

otherInfo: Instead of cabbage, green beans, zucchini and peas, moussaka can be prepared with spinach - about 400 g of vegetable per serving.
preparationDesc:
Wash the rice well. All vegetables are cleaned and cut into small cubes or strips.

In a pot with a little water, stew the carrots, celery, cabbage, green beans and peas without frying. Add the potatoes, zucchini, rice and tomatoes. The mixture is stirred and allowed to simmer briefly until half done.

Pour the vegetable mixture into a greased pan and add enough hot water or stock to cover. Bake in a moderate oven (180 °C) until the products are soft.

Beat the egg with the fresh milk. When the moussaka is almost ready, it is poured with the mixture and baked until the filling is slightly firm. After removing, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.

Pour the vegetable mixture into a greased pan and cover with hot water. Bake in a moderate oven (180 °C) until the rice is soft.

After removing, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve warm.

Sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve after cooling.

author: Yanko Petrov
preparationDesc:
artichokes and carrots are cleaned, washed and cut into thin slices or cubes. The onion is peeled and finely chopped. Wash the rice well. Tomatoes are peeled and chopped or pureed.
Mix the potatoes, carrots, rice, tomatoes and onions in a pan greased with a little fat. The products are poured with hot water, just enough to cover, and baked in a moderate oven (180 °C) until soft.

Beat the egg with the fresh milk. When the moussaka is almost ready, it is poured with the mixture and baked until the filling hardens.

The finished dish is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served warm

title: Lean potato moussaka

author: Yanko Petrov
preparationDesc:
The leek is cleaned, washed well and cut into slices. The rice is washed. Tomatoes are peeled if necessary and chopped or pureed.

In a vessel with a little water and the leek fat, the onion is stewed briefly without frying until soft. Add the rice and tomatoes and stir the mixture.

Pour the vegetable mixture into a greased pan and cover with hot water. Bake in a moderate oven (180 °C) until the rice is soft.

After removing, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve warm.
title: Through onions and rice

author: Yanko Petrov
preparationDesc:
Spinach is cleaned and washed well. If fresh, blanch briefly in hot water, then drain and coarsely chop. Potatoes are cleaned, washed and cut into thin slices or cubes. Onions and carrots are stewed until soft.

In a pan greased with a little fat, mix the onion with the carrots, potatoes and spinach. The products are poured with hot water, enough to cover them slightly, and baked in a moderate oven (180 °C) until the potatoes are soft.

 After removing, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.
title: Spinach with potatoes

author: Yanko Petrov
preparationDesc:

In a lightly greased pan, mix the cauliflower, rice and tomatoes. The products are poured with hot water, enough to cover them slightly, and baked in a moderate oven (180 °C) until the rice and vegetables are soft.

 After removing, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, poured with cold water and put on the fire, skimming the broth before it boils. Carrots and parsley roots, cut into pieces, and salt are added, after which cooking continues on low heat. When the vegetable roots are semi-soft, add the potatoes, cut into pieces, and the red tomatoes. The finished stew is seasoned with fresh butter, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served.
with a slice of lemon.
title: Boiled chicken

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
The meat is boned, cut into pieces and placed in cold water over high heat to boil quickly, skimmed, salted and left to boil over low heat. When the meat softens, add the carrots and white roots, cut into small cubes or grated. Fifteen to twenty minutes before removing the soup from the heat, add the rice and tomatoes, mashed or peeled and chopped into small pieces. After the rice is softened, a boiled mixture is added
yogurt, toasted flour and eggs. The finished soup is seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Beef soup

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The meat is washed, cut into pieces, placed in a pot of cold water over high heat. Before boiling, the broth is skimmed off, then salted and left to boil over low heat together with carrots and white roots, cleaned, washed and chopped. When the meat is almost cooked, add the rice, red tomatoes and onion. The soup is brought to a boil, built with a boiled structure of yogurt, toasted flour and eggs, seasoned with fresh butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Lamb soup

author: Yanko Petrov
preparationDesc:
Zucchini is washed and cut into cubes or washers. Wash the rice well. Tomatoes are peeled and chopped or pureed. Onions and carrots are cut into cubes and stewed in a little fat.

In a pan lightly greased with the fat, mix the zucchini, rice and tomatoes. They are poured with hot water, enough to lightly cover the products, and baked in a moderate oven (180 °C) until they soften and absorb the liquid.

The flour is beaten with a little water. The egg is beaten with the yogurt and mixed with the flour. When the moussaka is almost ready, it is poured with the mixture and baked until the filling is slightly firm. After removing, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley or dill.

The soup is brought to a boil, seasoned with the remaining fresh oil and served sprinkled with parsley
chopped parsley.
title: Minced beef soup

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The meat is ground in a meat grinder with a thick grid, mixed well with salt and part of the eggs, rice and finely chopped parsley and left to stand, after which it is formed into small balls (4-5 pieces per portion) with hands wetted with water. Place the chopped root vegetables in boiling salted water and cook until soft. Add the meatballs, the rest of the rice and finally the peeled and chopped tomatoes. The soup is brought to a boil, it is built up with a boiled structure of yogurt, toasted flour and the rest of the eggs, seasoned with fresh butter and sprinkled with the rest of the finely chopped parsley.

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The boneless meat is cut into small pieces, placed in a pot of cold water over high heat and brought to a rapid boil. The foam is removed and the meat is boiled until tender. The salt, the potatoes cut into cubes, the washed rice, the chopped peppers, tomatoes and carrots are added successively. Pour the beaten egg through a colander into the finished soup and mix. The soup is left to boil for another 5-10 minutes, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
