title: Country style soup

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Boneless, washed and cut into small pieces of meat is placed in a container of cold water and boiled over low heat. After removing the foam, add the salt, carrots and white roots, chopped or grated. As soon as the meat and roots are soft, add the diced potatoes and the red tomatoes, peeled and chopped or pureed. The finished soup is a boiled mixture of egg and yogurt, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
title: Beef and potato soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Boil the potatoes, carrots and (separately) the beetroot. Clean them and when they cool down, cut them into slices. Peas, cucumbers and peeled apples cut into cubes are added to them. Pour the lemon juice and vegetable oil over the salad and mix. 
Note: For diets No. 8, 9, the salad can be prepared without spices. Onions are allowed in diets No. 11, 15, and in diets No. 9, 10 - limited.
title: Vinaigrette Opera

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Well checked for doubles, fresh, healthy mushrooms are placed for a short time in water, then thoroughly washed and boiled in a small amount of salted water. They are drained and when they have cooled down, they are cut into pieces and mixed with finely chopped onions and dill or parsley. The prepared salad is poured with lemon juice (wine vinegar) and vegetable oil.
title: Mushroom salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Well checked for doubles, fresh, healthy mushrooms are placed for a short time in water, then thoroughly washed and boiled in a small amount of salted water. They are drained and when they have cooled down, they are cut into pieces and mixed with finely chopped onions and dill or parsley. The prepared salad is poured with lemon juice (wine vinegar) and vegetable oil.
title: Mushroom salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The beans are cleaned of impurities and low-quality grains, washed in several waters and placed in cold water to boil until soft, taking care not to damage the integrity of the beans. Drain and mix with the leek cut into rings and the finely chopped parsley. The prepared salad is salted and poured with vinegar and vegetable oil.
title: Ripe bean salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The cleaned and washed fish is ground in a meat grinder. Add 1/2 of the rice, egg, parsley, butter and salt to the minced meat. After mixing well, form small balls from the mixture (5-6 per portion). Boil the cleaned, washed and chopped root vegetables in boiling salted water. When they soften, add the prepared fish balls and the remaining half of the rice. The finished soup is built with a cooked structure of toasted flour, yogurt and the rest of the egg, seasoned with the separated half of the butter and sprinkled with the finely chopped parsley reserved for this purpose.
title: Soup with fish balls

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The fish is washed and deboned. Her flesh is cut into pieces, and broth is made from her bones. The cleaned, washed and chopped root vegetables are stewed in a part of the oil and a little water, poured with the boiling broth and cooked until soft. The diced potatoes, the fish cut into pieces and the pureed tomatoes are successively added to them. The boiled soup is seasoned with the rest of the butter, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served with a slice of lemon.
title: Fish and potato soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The fish is washed and deboned. Her flesh is cut into pieces, and broth is made from her bones. The cleaned, washed and chopped root vegetables are stewed in a part of the oil and a little water, poured with the boiling broth and cooked until soft. The diced potatoes, the fish cut into pieces and the pureed tomatoes are successively added to them. The boiled soup is seasoned with the rest of the butter, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served with a slice of lemon.
title: Fish and potato soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The fish or fish fillet is washed and cut into portions. Peeled carrots are grated and stewed in some of the fat. In boiling broth (from the fish bones) or in boiling water, the peeled and chopped potatoes, stewed carrots and chopped peppers are successively boiled until soft, then the chopped fish, peeled and chopped tomatoes and olives are added. The finished soup is seasoned with the rest of the butter, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served with a slice of lemon.
Note:
Soup for diet No. 10 is prepared without salt. 1/2 portion can be relaxed.
title: Fish and olive soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed roots are grated or chopped and stewed in some butter, then put in boiling water or stock together with the cleaned, washed and diced potatoes and salt. After boiling for 15-20 minutes, add the pureed tomatoes. The finished soup is removed from the fire and built with a boiled construction of the egg, toasted flour and yogurt, seasoned with the rest of the fresh butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
For diet No. 6, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt.
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand.
With diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
For diets No. 10, 11, 15, onions can be added.
title: Potato soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Root vegetables are cleaned and washed, finely chopped or grated and stewed in some oil and a little water. Potatoes are peeled and washed, cut into cubes and placed in boiling water or broth. The stewed roots and rice are successively added to them. Ten minutes before removing the soup from the heat, add the pureed tomatoes. The soup is made with the egg and yogurt and seasoned with the rest of the fresh butter, and when served, it is sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
For diet No. 6, the soup can be prepared without salt and fat.
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, the necessary amount of salt is given by hand.
With diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
For diets No. 10, 11, 15, onions can be added to the soup.
title: Potato soup with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The peas are cleaned from the pods, washed and placed in hot water. To it, as it softens, successively cleaned, washed and chopped potatoes and previously stewed carrots are added. At the end of cooking, add the pureed tomatoes. The finished soup is built up with yogurt and egg, seasoned with the rest of the butter and sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
For diet No. 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, the necessary amount of salt is given by hand.
1/2 serving of soup can be left out.
title: Potato and green pea soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Root vegetables are cleaned and washed, grated and stewed in some of the fat and a little water. As soon as they soften, add the cleaned, washed and chopped green beans. They are poured with hot water, salted and left to boil. At the end of cooking, add the pureed tomatoes. The finished soup is made with a boiled mixture of yogurt, flour and egg, seasoned with fresh butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note:
For diet No. 8, the soup is prepared without fat and salt.
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted.
With diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Green Bean Soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Grated carrots are stewed in part of the oil and a little water, poured with hot water, salted and boiled. Add the finely chopped beans. When the beans soften, add the diced potatoes, and towards the end of cooking, add the mashed tomatoes. The finished soup is built up with the egg and yogurt and seasoned with the rest of the fresh butter, and when served, it is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note:
For diet No. 8, the soup is prepared without fat and salt.
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted.
With diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Green Bean and Potato Soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Grated carrots are stewed in part of the oil and a little water, poured with hot water, salted and boiled. Add the finely chopped beans. When the beans soften, add the diced potatoes, and towards the end of cooking, add the mashed tomatoes. The finished soup is built up with the egg and yogurt and seasoned with the rest of the fresh butter, and when served, it is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note:
For diet No. 8, the soup is prepared without fat and salt.
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted.
With diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Green Bean and Potato Soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Zucchini are washed and cut, then together with the carrots grated and stewed in a part of the oil, they are poured with hot water and boiled for 10-15 minutes. The cleaned and washed rice is added to them. The finished soup is removed from the fire and built up with a boiled construction of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with the rest of the fresh butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
With diets No. 6 and 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt.
The amount of rice in diets No. 8 and 9 is reduced to 3 g.
For diets No. 7, 8 and 10, the soup is prepared without salt.
With diets No. 8 and 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Zucchini soup with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The eggs are broken one by one carefully so as not to break their integrity, placed in a container with the heated fat and cooked in a steamer or in a water bath until the whites turn white, then they are salted, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: The dish is prepared only from guaranteed eggs obtained from salmonella-free poultry farms.
title: Eggs in the eyes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The eggs are broken and mixed with salt and finely chopped parsley, poured into a container with the heated fat and cooked in a water bath or steamed, stirring from time to time. Serve immediately after preparation.
title: Scrambled eggs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The broken eggs are beaten together with the fresh milk, salted and poured into a pan with the heated fat. The omelette is baked in a water bath or in an oven at a moderate temperature until done. Cut into squares, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve immediately.
title: Natural omelette

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Eggs are beaten with fresh milk and half-cooked rice and mashed or peeled and chopped tomatoes are added to them. The mixture is salted and poured into a container with the heated fat, then baked in a water bath or in an oven. The finished omelette is cut into portions, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case the yield is 165 g.
title: Omelette with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Cut the cauliflower into small pieces, wash and boil in salted water. The eggs are beaten with the fresh milk and the boiled cauliflower is added to them. The mixture is placed in a container with the fat and baked in a water bath or in an oven. The finished omelet is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley, cut into portions and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case, the yield is 180 g.
title: Omelet with cauliflower (cauliflower)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Vegetables are boiled. Carrots and potatoes, cut into cubes, and cauliflower, cut into small pieces, are mixed together with the peas. Eggs beaten with fresh milk and salt are added to them. The mixture is placed in a container with fat and baked in a water bath or in an oven. The finished omelet is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case, the yield is 180 g.
For diets No. 1, 4, 5, the omelet is prepared without green peas.
title: Omelet with vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Carrots are washed and cleaned, cut into small cubes and stewed in a part of the oil and a little water. The sterilized cucumbers are drained, cut into cubes and mixed with the stewed carrots, after which the pre-beaten eggs are added along with the milk. The mixture is placed in a container with the fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The finished omelette is served immediately.
title: Omelette Mosaic

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The meat is ground in a meat grinder with a thick grid, mixed well with salt and part of the eggs, rice and finely chopped parsley and left to stand, after which it is formed into small balls (4-5 pieces per portion) with hands wetted with water. Place the chopped root vegetables in boiling salted water and cook until soft. Add the meatballs, the rest of the rice and finally the peeled and chopped tomatoes. The soup is brought to a boil, it is built up with a boiled structure of yogurt, toasted flour and the rest of the eggs, seasoned with fresh butter and sprinkled with the rest of the finely chopped parsley.
title: Soup with beef balls

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed cauliflower is boiled in salted water until soft (without overcooking), drained, allowed to cool and broken into twigs. Add the prepared tomatoes and cucumbers, cut into slices, and the peas. Mix and season with salt, lemon juice (wine vinegar) and vegetable oil. Before serving, sprinkle the salad with finely chopped parsley or celery leaves.
Note: Onions are allowed in diets No. 11, 15, and in diets No. 9, 10 — limited.
Salt is limited to a complete ban in diets No. 7, 8, 10. In diet No. 8, the salad can be served without spices or their quantity is reduced by half.
title: Cauliflower salad and other vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The beans are cleaned of impurities and low-quality grains, washed in several waters and placed in cold water to boil until soft, taking care not to damage the integrity of the beans. Drain and mix with the leek cut into rings and the finely chopped parsley. The prepared salad is salted and poured with vinegar and vegetable oil.
title: Ripe bean salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The celery is washed and boiled, and when it cools down, it is peeled and cut into slices or sticks, salted and mixed with the squeezed yogurt.
title: Celery salad and squeezed yogurt

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The boneless, washed and cut meat is poured with cold water and boiled over moderate heat. After the broth is skimmed off, add the grated or chopped root vegetables and salt, and later the well-washed and chopped cauliflower. The soup is boiled for another 15-20 minutes, it is built up with a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with fresh oil and sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 6, 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt.
For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the soup is not salted.
At the discretion of the dietician, the soup can be prepared without any seasoning.
title: Beef and cauliflower soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The boneless, washed and cut meat is poured with cold water and boiled over moderate heat. After the broth is skimmed off, add the grated or chopped root vegetables and salt, and later the well-washed and chopped cauliflower. The soup is boiled for another 15-20 minutes, it is built up with a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with fresh oil and sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 6, 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt.
For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the soup is not salted.
At the discretion of the dietician, the soup can be prepared without any seasoning.
title: Beef and cauliflower soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Grated root vegetables are lightly stewed in some of the fat and a little water (the soup can be prepared without steaming them beforehand) and poured with hot water. Add the previously washed and mashed tomatoes. After boiling them, add the rice. The finished soup is built up with a boiled build-up of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with the rest of the butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 1 and 4, the soup is prepared with 40 g of red tomatoes.
For diets No. 7 and 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, the necessary amount of salt is given by hand.
With diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
In diet No. 9, the soup is prepared with 3 g of rice.
title: Red tomato soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Zucchini are washed and cut, then together with the carrots grated and stewed in a part of the oil, they are poured with hot water and boiled for 10-15 minutes. The cleaned and washed rice is added to them. The finished soup is removed from the fire and built up with a boiled construction of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with the rest of the fresh butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
With diets No. 6 and 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt.
The amount of rice in diets No. 8 and 9 is reduced to 3 g.
For diets No. 7, 8 and 10, the soup is prepared without salt.
With diets No. 8 and 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Zucchini soup with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Carrots, white roots and onions are cleaned, washed and cut into small pieces, then stewed in some fat and a little water until soft, covered with hot water, salted and left to boil for a while. Add the spinach, well washed and chopped, and the cleaned rice. A little later, the tomatoes are added, peeled and finely chopped or pureed. The finished soup is built up with a boiled build-up of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with the remaining amount of fresh oil and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
The amount of rice in diet No. 9 is reduced to 3 g.
For diet No. 10, the soup is prepared without salt. 1/2 serving of soup can be left out.
title: Spinach soup with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Cleaned and washed leeks are finely chopped and placed in hot water to boil. When the leek softens, add the salt, the washed rice and the tomatoes, mashed or peeled and cut into small pieces. The soup is brought to a boil and topped with a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with fresh butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
The amount of rice in diets No. 8 and 9 is reduced to 3 g.
For diet No. 10, the soup is prepared without salt. 1/2 serving of soup can be left out.
title: Leek soup with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Grated carrots and white roots are stewed in a part of the oil and a little water, then poured with hot water or broth (depending on the requirements of the diet) and boiled. Add the salad leaves cleaned of the central vein and cut into strips and the washed rice. The soup is brought to a boil and topped with a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with the rest of the butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 6 and 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt.
The amount of rice in diets No. 8 and 9 is reduced to 3 g.
For diets No. 7 and 10, the soup is not salted.
With diets No. 8 and 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Spring soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The eggs are broken one by one carefully so as not to break their integrity, placed in a container with the heated fat and cooked in a steamer or in a water bath until the whites turn white, then they are salted, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: The dish is prepared only from guaranteed eggs obtained from salmonella-free poultry farms.
title: Eggs in the eyes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The eggs are broken one by one and placed in boiling water salted and slightly acidified with vinegar to boil for a few minutes at a gentle boil, until the yolk is covered with the white, after which they are removed with a slotted spoon, placed in a plate with the yogurt (the cheese cut into portions) and served immediately.
Note: The dish is prepared only from guaranteed eggs. When the eggs are served on strained yogurt or on cheese, the yield is 130 g.
title: Panagura eggs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The whites are carefully separated from the yolks, beaten and mixed with fresh milk. The crushed cheese and the peeled and chopped or pureed tomatoes are added to them. The mixture is poured into a container with the heated fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The finished omelette is cut into squares, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately with or without a side dish.
title: Omelette with egg whites

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Vegetables are boiled. Carrots and potatoes, cut into cubes, and cauliflower, cut into small pieces, are mixed together with the peas. Eggs beaten with fresh milk and salt are added to them. The mixture is placed in a container with fat and baked in a water bath or in an oven. The finished omelet is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case, the yield is 180 g.
For diets No. 1, 4, 5, the omelet is prepared without green peas.
title: Omelet with vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of tendons, skins and fat, washed, cut into pieces and boiled, then ground in a meat grinder or cut into cubes, mixed with previously stewed tomatoes and salted. The eggs are beaten with the fresh milk and half of the egg mixture is poured into a container with the fat and half-baked in a water bath or in the oven. Add the meat and tomato stuffing and pour in the rest of the egg mixture. The omelette is baked and served immediately.
The meat prepared for the filling can be added to the egg mixture, after which the omelette is baked.
title: Omelette with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The sausages are peeled and cut into thin circles. Eggs beaten together with milk and salt are added to them. The mixture is placed in a container with the fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The finished omelet is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case the yield is 155 g.
title: Omelet with dietary sausages

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Fresh cottage cheese is beaten with sour or fresh milk until a fluffy mixture is obtained, which is served chilled.
title: Cottage cheese with milk

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The vegetables are washed, then the tomatoes and cucumbers are peeled, and the peppers are cleaned from the stalks and seeds and everything is cut into small pieces.
The cottage cheese is beaten with the yogurt until a fluffy mixture is obtained, to which the finely chopped vegetables, parsley or dill are added. The mixture is salted and carefully mixed. It is served chilled, garnished with pieces of vegetables.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Cottage cheese with vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Cherries are washed and cleaned of pits and stalks. Juice is squeezed from them, which is preserved in a non-oxidizing container in the cold. The rest of the fruit is poured with hot water, boiled for a few minutes and filtered. Sugar and starch dissolved in cold water are added to the resulting liquid, after it boils, with constant stirring. Boil the mixture for 1-2 minutes, then add the squeezed juice and stir. The prepared pickle is poured into bowls moistened with cold water. It is served chilled.
Note. Cherries are not used for diets No. 1 and 6. For diets No. 8 and 9, pickle is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Sour cherries

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The sausages are peeled and cut into thin circles. Eggs beaten together with milk and salt are added to them. The mixture is placed in a container with the fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The finished omelet is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case the yield is 155 g.
title: Omelet with dietary sausages

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The peppers are washed, deseeded, cut and stewed in some of the fat and a little water until soft, then the peeled and chopped or pureed tomatoes are added. Beat the eggs in a separate bowl and add the grated cheese and stewed vegetables to them. The mixture is salted, poured into a container with the fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The prepared omelet is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately. When canned paprika is used for the omelette, fresh peppers and tomatoes are not added.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the omelette is prepared without salt and the cheese is desalted.
title: Omelet with peppers, tomatoes and cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The fruits, selected according to the requirements of the diet, are drained of the juice and, if necessary, allowed to boil until completely softened. Add the drained juice from the compote, sugar and water. The rest is done as for making sour apples.
Note. Apricots are not used for diets No. 1 and 6. For diets No. 8 and 9, pickle is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Sterilized fruit sour

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The nectar is diluted with the water and allowed to boil together with the sugar. Add the semolina in a thin stream and with continuous stirring. The mixture is boiled for 5-6 minutes until thickened, cooled and beaten in a whisk (or with a wire) until a thick foam is formed.
Note. For diets No. 1 and 6, mousse is not prepared from apricots, for diets No. 8 and 9 it is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — without an additional amount of sugar.
title: Nectar mousse with semolina

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The washed and pitted fruits are cut into pieces, poured with boiling water and boiled until completely soft, after which they are pureed. Sugar and pre-soaked gelatin in a little cold water are added to the resulting fruit puree until swollen. The mixture is heated to a boil, removed from the heat and stirred until the gelatin melts, cooled until semi-gelled and mixed gently with the added egg whites beaten with sugar. The prepared mousse is poured into serving bowls, previously rinsed with cold water, and left to gel in the cold. Before serving, each bowl is dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned over in a saucer.
Note. Mousse is made only from guaranteed eggs. For diets No. 8 and 9 it is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, for diets No. 1 and 6 without apricots, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Apricot (peach) mousse with gelatin

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Juice is squeezed from the fruits and stored in a cool place. Some of the skins are grated, poured with cold water and left to boil. To the decoction, after straining, add sugar and starch dissolved in a little cold water, stirring constantly. The mixture is boiled for 1-2 minutes. Further, the pickle is prepared like sour cherry (rec. 514).
Note. For diets No. 1 and 6, lemons are not used. For diets No. 8 and 9, pickle is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Citrus Sour

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The coffee (cocoa, tea) is placed in the boiling water and strained as it boils. The rest is carried out as for the preparation of sour apples.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, pickle is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Coffee sour (cocoa, Russian tea)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
To the sweetened boiling milk, diluted with water, add the starch dissolved in a little cold milk, stirring constantly and boil for 1-2 minutes. The prepared sour cream is removed from the heat, flavored with vanilla and poured into bowls rinsed with cold water.
Note. For diet No. 9, pickle is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Milk sour

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Juice is obtained from the well-washed fruits, which is stored in a non-oxidizing container in the cold. The rest of the fruit (the seed part and the husks) is poured with the specified amount of hot water and boiled for a few minutes. The decoction is filtered and, after it boils again, sugar and semolina are added - gradually and with constant stirring. The mixture is boiled for 5-6 minutes until thickened, cooled and beaten together with the fruit juice in a whisk (or with a wire) until a thick foam is formed.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, the mousse is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, for diet No. 7 — without blueberries, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Strawberry mousse (raspberries, blackberries, blackcurrants, blueberries)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Washed and cleaned fruits (pits are removed from peaches and apricots) are cut into pieces, poured with boiling water and boiled until completely soft, then pureed. The resulting fruit puree is sweetened with sugar and, after it boils again, the semolina is added gradually and with constant stirring. The mixture is boiled for 5-6 minutes until thickened, cooled and beaten in a whisk (or with a wire) until a thick foam is formed.
Note. For diets No. 1 and 6, the mousse is not prepared with apricots. For diets No. 8 and 9, the mousse is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Apple mousse (peaches, apricots) with semolina

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Juice is squeezed from the well-washed and cleaned fruits, which is stored in a non-oxidizing container in the cold. The rest of the fruit (the seed part and the husks) is poured with hot water and boiled for a few minutes. The decoction is filtered, sweetened with sugar, mixed with the acid and gelatin pre-soaked in a little cold water, heated again until boiling and cooled. The obtained fruit juice is added. The mixture is strained, poured into serving bowls, rinsed with cold water, and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the jelly, the bowls are dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Fresh fruit jelly

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The boneless meat is cut into small pieces, placed in a pot of cold water over high heat and brought to a rapid boil. The foam is removed and the meat is boiled until tender. The salt, the potatoes cut into cubes, the washed rice, the chopped peppers, tomatoes and carrots are added successively. Pour the beaten egg through a colander into the finished soup and mix. The soup is left to boil for another 5-10 minutes, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Country style soup

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Boneless, washed and cut into small pieces of meat is placed in a container of cold water and boiled over low heat. After removing the foam, add the salt, carrots and white roots, chopped or grated. As soon as the meat and roots are soft, add the diced potatoes and the red tomatoes, peeled and chopped or pureed. The finished soup is a boiled mixture of egg and yogurt, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
title: Beef and potato soup

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The meat is deboned, washed and cut into small pieces, poured with cold water and boiled until semi-soft. The chopped root vegetables and salt are added, and later the cabbage, cut into strips, and the peeled and chopped tomatoes are added successively. The finished soup is removed from the fire, built with a cooked structure of toasted flour, yogurt and eggs, seasoned with fresh butter, sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley and served.
title: Beef and white cabbage soup

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The meat is deboned, washed and cut into small pieces, poured with cold water and boiled until semi-soft. The chopped root vegetables and salt are added, and later the cabbage, cut into strips, and the peeled and chopped tomatoes are added successively. The finished soup is removed from the fire, built with a cooked structure of toasted flour, yogurt and eggs, seasoned with fresh butter, sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley and served.
title: Beef and white cabbage soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed cauliflower is boiled in salted water until soft (without overcooking), drained, allowed to cool and broken into twigs. Add the prepared tomatoes and cucumbers, cut into slices, and the peas. Mix and season with salt, lemon juice (wine vinegar) and vegetable oil. Before serving, sprinkle the salad with finely chopped parsley or celery leaves.
Note: Onions are allowed in diets No. 11, 15, and in diets No. 9, 10 — limited.
Salt is limited to a complete ban in diets No. 7, 8, 10. In diet No. 8, the salad can be served without spices or their quantity is reduced by half.
title: Cauliflower salad and other vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The beetroot is washed well, placed unpeeled in cold water acidified with a part of the vinegar and boiled until soft. It is drained from the water and when it cools, it is peeled, cut into thin slices, cubes, sticks or coarsely grated, salted, poured with lemon juice (wine vinegar) and vegetable oil and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note: In diets No. 1, 4, 6, red beets are finely grated. In diets No. 6, 8, 9, the salad can be served without spices or their quantity is reduced by half. Salt is limited to a complete ban in diets No. 6, 7, 8, 10. Lemon juice is given in all diets, but its amount varies from 1 to 4 g.
title: Beetroot salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Boil the potatoes, carrots and, separately from them, in water acidified with vinegar - the beetroot. Then, while they are still warm, they are peeled, and when they cool down, they are cut into cubes. Add the cabbage, cut into strips, the peeled and sliced ​​apples, the peas and the boiled and diced egg. The salad is salted, poured with lemon juice (wine vinegar) and vegetable oil and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: Salt is limited to a complete ban in diets No. 7, 10.
title: Winter vinaigrette

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The beans are boiled and drained, then mixed with the sliced ​​sauerkraut and finely chopped onion. The prepared salad is poured with vegetable oil and sprinkled with red pepper.
Note: When compiling the menu for diet No. 9, keep in mind that the amount of carbohydrates in 100 g of beans is approximately the same as the amount of carbohydrates in 100 g of bread.
title: Salad of ripe beans and sauerkraut

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The celery is washed and boiled, and when it cools down, it is peeled and cut into slices or sticks, salted and mixed with the squeezed yogurt.
title: Celery salad and squeezed yogurt

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Blue tomatoes are roasted, peeled and cut lengthwise, arranged on a plate and salted, poured with vinegar (lemon juice) to which crushed garlic has been added, and vegetable oil and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Blue tomato salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat, cut into pieces, is put to boil. The red beetroot, cut into straws, is stewed until softened in a part of the butter together with the sugar and a part of the pureed tomatoes (vinegar). The chopped carrots and white roots are added to the semi-cooked meat, then the cabbage, cut into strips, the stewed beetroot and the remaining pureed tomatoes are successively added. When serving the borscht, put unbeaten yogurt (cream) on the plates and sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted.
At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand.
For diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be given.
title: Borscht with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat, cut into pieces, is put to boil. The red beetroot, cut into straws, is stewed until softened in a part of the butter together with the sugar and a part of the pureed tomatoes (vinegar). The chopped carrots and white roots are added to the semi-cooked meat, then the cabbage, cut into strips, the stewed beetroot and the remaining pureed tomatoes are successively added. When serving the borscht, put unbeaten yogurt (cream) on the plates and sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted.
At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand.
For diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be given.
title: Borscht with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The tripe is cleaned very well, covered with cold water and boiled for a long time in an open vessel until soft. The boiled tripe is taken out, and hot fresh milk is poured into the broth and salt is added. The tripe is chopped (cut) into small pieces and returned to the broth. When serving, add fresh butter and sweet red pepper to each portion.
Note:
For diet No. 1 and 4, only the broth is used without the tripe.
For diets 9, 10, 11, 15, the soup is seasoned with crushed garlic and sweet red pepper.
title: Beef tripe soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The cleaned and washed fish is ground in a meat grinder. Add 1/2 of the rice, egg, parsley, butter and salt to the minced meat. After mixing well, form small balls from the mixture (5-6 per portion). Boil the cleaned, washed and chopped root vegetables in boiling salted water. When they soften, add the prepared fish balls and the remaining half of the rice. The finished soup is built with a cooked structure of toasted flour, yogurt and the rest of the egg, seasoned with the separated half of the butter and sprinkled with the finely chopped parsley reserved for this purpose.
title: Soup with fish balls

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed roots are grated or chopped and stewed in some butter, then put in boiling water or stock together with the cleaned, washed and diced potatoes and salt. After boiling for 15-20 minutes, add the pureed tomatoes. The finished soup is removed from the fire and built with a boiled construction of the egg, toasted flour and yogurt, seasoned with the rest of the fresh butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
For diet No. 6, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt.
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand.
With diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
For diets No. 10, 11, 15, onions can be added.
title: Potato soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Grated root vegetables are lightly stewed in some of the fat and a little water (the soup can be prepared without steaming them beforehand) and poured with hot water. Add the previously washed and mashed tomatoes. After boiling them, add the rice. The finished soup is built up with a boiled build-up of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with the rest of the butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 1 and 4, the soup is prepared with 40 g of red tomatoes.
For diets No. 7 and 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, the necessary amount of salt is given by hand.
With diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
In diet No. 9, the soup is prepared with 3 g of rice.
title: Red tomato soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Carrots, white roots and onions are cleaned, washed and cut into small pieces, then stewed in some fat and a little water until soft, covered with hot water, salted and left to boil for a while. Add the spinach, well washed and chopped, and the cleaned rice. A little later, the tomatoes are added, peeled and finely chopped or pureed. The finished soup is built up with a boiled build-up of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with the remaining amount of fresh oil and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
The amount of rice in diet No. 9 is reduced to 3 g.
For diet No. 10, the soup is prepared without salt. 1/2 serving of soup can be left out.
title: Spinach soup with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The eggs are broken and mixed with salt and finely chopped parsley, poured into a container with the heated fat and cooked in a water bath or steamed, stirring from time to time. Serve immediately after preparation.
title: Scrambled eggs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The broken eggs are beaten together with the fresh milk, salted and poured into a pan with the heated fat. The omelette is baked in a water bath or in an oven at a moderate temperature until done. Cut into squares, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve immediately.
title: Natural omelette

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cottage cheese is beaten with the yogurt and vegetable oil until a fluffy mixture is obtained. Add the cleaned, washed and finely chopped lettuce leaves, radishes, parsley and green onions. The mixture is salted and gently stirred. Serve chilled, garnished with radishes and parsley leaves.
Note: For diets No. 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 5 — without onions.
title: Cottage cheese with lettuce and radishes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The cottage cheese is beaten with the yogurt and lutenica until a fluffy mixture is obtained, which is served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Cottage cheese with lutenitsa

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Washed peaches (apricots) are cleaned from the pits, cut into large pieces, poured with hot water and boiled in a covered pot until soft, then pureed. Next, the pickle is prepared like apple pickle.
Note. Apricots are not used for diets No. 1 and 6. For diets No. 8 and 9, pickle is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Sour peaches (apricots)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The nectar (fruit juice) is diluted with water and allowed to boil. The starch diluted with a little cold water is added with continuous stirring. The mixture is boiled for 1-2 minutes. The prepared pickle is poured into bowls moistened with cold water. It is served chilled.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, pickle is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener. No additional sugar is added to pickle for diet No. 6.
title: Nectar Sour (fruit juice)

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The boneless meat is cut into small pieces, placed in a pot of cold water over high heat and brought to a rapid boil. The foam is removed and the meat is boiled until tender. The salt, the potatoes cut into cubes, the washed rice, the chopped peppers, tomatoes and carrots are added successively. Pour the beaten egg through a colander into the finished soup and mix. The soup is left to boil for another 5-10 minutes, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Country style soup

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The boneless meat is cut into small pieces, placed in a pot of cold water over high heat and brought to a rapid boil. The foam is removed and the meat is boiled until tender. The salt, the potatoes cut into cubes, the washed rice, the chopped peppers, tomatoes and carrots are added successively. Pour the beaten egg through a colander into the finished soup and mix. The soup is left to boil for another 5-10 minutes, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Country style soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The beetroot is washed well, placed unpeeled in cold water acidified with a part of the vinegar and boiled until soft. It is drained from the water and when it cools, it is peeled, cut into thin slices, cubes, sticks or coarsely grated, salted, poured with lemon juice (wine vinegar) and vegetable oil and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note: In diets No. 1, 4, 6, red beets are finely grated. In diets No. 6, 8, 9, the salad can be served without spices or their quantity is reduced by half. Salt is limited to a complete ban in diets No. 6, 7, 8, 10. Lemon juice is given in all diets, but its amount varies from 1 to 4 g.
title: Beetroot salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Boil the potatoes, carrots and (separately) the beetroot. Clean them and when they cool down, cut them into slices. Peas, cucumbers and peeled apples cut into cubes are added to them. Pour the lemon juice and vegetable oil over the salad and mix. 
Note: For diets No. 8, 9, the salad can be prepared without spices. Onions are allowed in diets No. 11, 15, and in diets No. 9, 10 - limited.
title: Vinaigrette Opera

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Boil the potatoes, carrots and, separately from them, in water acidified with vinegar - the beetroot. Then, while they are still warm, they are peeled, and when they cool down, they are cut into cubes. Add the cabbage, cut into strips, the peeled and sliced ​​apples, the peas and the boiled and diced egg. The salad is salted, poured with lemon juice (wine vinegar) and vegetable oil and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: Salt is limited to a complete ban in diets No. 7, 10.
title: Winter vinaigrette

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The beans are boiled and drained, then mixed with the sliced ​​sauerkraut and finely chopped onion. The prepared salad is poured with vegetable oil and sprinkled with red pepper.
Note: When compiling the menu for diet No. 9, keep in mind that the amount of carbohydrates in 100 g of beans is approximately the same as the amount of carbohydrates in 100 g of bread.
title: Salad of ripe beans and sauerkraut

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Blue tomatoes are roasted, peeled and cut lengthwise, arranged on a plate and salted, poured with vinegar (lemon juice) to which crushed garlic has been added, and vegetable oil and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Blue tomato salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The tripe is cleaned very well, covered with cold water and boiled for a long time in an open vessel until soft. The boiled tripe is taken out, and hot fresh milk is poured into the broth and salt is added. The tripe is chopped (cut) into small pieces and returned to the broth. When serving, add fresh butter and sweet red pepper to each portion.
Note:
For diet No. 1 and 4, only the broth is used without the tripe.
For diets 9, 10, 11, 15, the soup is seasoned with crushed garlic and sweet red pepper.
title: Beef tripe soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The fish or fish fillet is washed and cut into portions. Peeled carrots are grated and stewed in some of the fat. In boiling broth (from the fish bones) or in boiling water, the peeled and chopped potatoes, stewed carrots and chopped peppers are successively boiled until soft, then the chopped fish, peeled and chopped tomatoes and olives are added. The finished soup is seasoned with the rest of the butter, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served with a slice of lemon.
Note:
Soup for diet No. 10 is prepared without salt. 1/2 portion can be relaxed.
title: Fish and olive soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Root vegetables are cleaned and washed, finely chopped or grated and stewed in some oil and a little water. Potatoes are peeled and washed, cut into cubes and placed in boiling water or broth. The stewed roots and rice are successively added to them. Ten minutes before removing the soup from the heat, add the pureed tomatoes. The soup is made with the egg and yogurt and seasoned with the rest of the fresh butter, and when served, it is sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
For diet No. 6, the soup can be prepared without salt and fat.
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, the necessary amount of salt is given by hand.
With diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
For diets No. 10, 11, 15, onions can be added to the soup.
title: Potato soup with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The peas are cleaned from the pods, washed and placed in hot water. To it, as it softens, successively cleaned, washed and chopped potatoes and previously stewed carrots are added. At the end of cooking, add the pureed tomatoes. The finished soup is built up with yogurt and egg, seasoned with the rest of the butter and sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
For diet No. 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, the necessary amount of salt is given by hand.
1/2 serving of soup can be left out.
title: Potato and green pea soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Put the cleaned, washed and grated carrots in boiling water, and a little later - potatoes cut into medium-sized pieces. When the vegetables soften and the soup is removed from the heat, add the fresh butter and grated cheese.
title: Potato soup with cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Put the cleaned, washed and grated carrots in boiling water, and a little later - potatoes cut into medium-sized pieces. When the vegetables soften and the soup is removed from the heat, add the fresh butter and grated cheese.
title: Potato soup with cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Root vegetables are cleaned and washed, grated and stewed in some of the fat and a little water. As soon as they soften, add the cleaned, washed and chopped green beans. They are poured with hot water, salted and left to boil. At the end of cooking, add the pureed tomatoes. The finished soup is made with a boiled mixture of yogurt, flour and egg, seasoned with fresh butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note:
For diet No. 8, the soup is prepared without fat and salt.
For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted.
With diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Green Bean Soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Cleaned and washed leeks are finely chopped and placed in hot water to boil. When the leek softens, add the salt, the washed rice and the tomatoes, mashed or peeled and cut into small pieces. The soup is brought to a boil and topped with a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with fresh butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
The amount of rice in diets No. 8 and 9 is reduced to 3 g.
For diet No. 10, the soup is prepared without salt. 1/2 serving of soup can be left out.
title: Leek soup with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Grated carrots and white roots are stewed in a part of the oil and a little water, then poured with hot water or broth (depending on the requirements of the diet) and boiled. Add the salad leaves cleaned of the central vein and cut into strips and the washed rice. The soup is brought to a boil and topped with a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and egg, seasoned with the rest of the butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 6 and 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt.
The amount of rice in diets No. 8 and 9 is reduced to 3 g.
For diets No. 7 and 10, the soup is not salted.
With diets No. 8 and 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Spring soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The eggs are broken one by one and placed in boiling water salted and slightly acidified with vinegar to boil for a few minutes at a gentle boil, until the yolk is covered with the white, after which they are removed with a slotted spoon, placed in a plate with the yogurt (the cheese cut into portions) and served immediately.
Note: The dish is prepared only from guaranteed eggs. When the eggs are served on strained yogurt or on cheese, the yield is 130 g.
title: Panagura eggs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The whites are carefully separated from the yolks, beaten and mixed with fresh milk. The crushed cheese and the peeled and chopped or pureed tomatoes are added to them. The mixture is poured into a container with the heated fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The finished omelette is cut into squares, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately with or without a side dish.
title: Omelette with egg whites

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cheese is rinsed and crumbled into small pieces. The eggs are beaten and mixed with the fresh milk and the crumbled cheese. The mixture is poured into a suitable container with the heated fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The finished omelette is cut into portions, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served alone or with various salads and side dishes.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case, the yield is 125 g.
title: Omelette with cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cheese is rinsed and crumbled into small pieces. The eggs are beaten and mixed with the fresh milk and the crumbled cheese. The mixture is poured into a suitable container with the heated fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The finished omelette is cut into portions, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served alone or with various salads and side dishes.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case, the yield is 125 g.
title: Omelette with cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Eggs are beaten with fresh milk and half-cooked rice and mashed or peeled and chopped tomatoes are added to them. The mixture is salted and poured into a container with the heated fat, then baked in a water bath or in an oven. The finished omelette is cut into portions, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case the yield is 165 g.
title: Omelette with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Carrots are washed and cleaned, grated and stewed in some fat and a little water. The eggs are beaten with the fresh milk and the stewed carrots are added to them. The mixture is salted, poured into a container in which the rest of the fat is placed, and baked in a water bath or in an oven. The finished omelette is cut into portions, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case, the yield is 180 g.
title: Omelet with carrots

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Carrots are washed and cleaned, grated and stewed in some fat and a little water. The eggs are beaten with the fresh milk and the stewed carrots are added to them. The mixture is salted, poured into a container in which the rest of the fat is placed, and baked in a water bath or in an oven. The finished omelette is cut into portions, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case, the yield is 180 g.
title: Omelet with carrots

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Cut the cauliflower into small pieces, wash and boil in salted water. The eggs are beaten with the fresh milk and the boiled cauliflower is added to them. The mixture is placed in a container with the fat and baked in a water bath or in an oven. The finished omelet is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley, cut into portions and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 4, 5, 10, the omelet can be prepared with 3 pcs. egg whites. In this case, the yield is 180 g.
title: Omelet with cauliflower (cauliflower)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Carrots are washed and cleaned, cut into small cubes and stewed in a part of the oil and a little water. The sterilized cucumbers are drained, cut into cubes and mixed with the stewed carrots, after which the pre-beaten eggs are added along with the milk. The mixture is placed in a container with the fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The finished omelette is served immediately.
title: Omelette Mosaic

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of tendons, skins and fat, washed, cut into pieces and boiled, then ground in a meat grinder or cut into cubes, mixed with previously stewed tomatoes and salted. The eggs are beaten with the fresh milk and half of the egg mixture is poured into a container with the fat and half-baked in a water bath or in the oven. Add the meat and tomato stuffing and pour in the rest of the egg mixture. The omelette is baked and served immediately.
The meat prepared for the filling can be added to the egg mixture, after which the omelette is baked.
title: Omelette with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The peppers are washed, deseeded, cut and stewed in some of the fat and a little water until soft, then the peeled and chopped or pureed tomatoes are added. Beat the eggs in a separate bowl and add the grated cheese and stewed vegetables to them. The mixture is salted, poured into a container with the fat and baked in an oven or in a water bath. The prepared omelet is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately. When canned paprika is used for the omelette, fresh peppers and tomatoes are not added.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the omelette is prepared without salt and the cheese is desalted.
title: Omelet with peppers, tomatoes and cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova

ingredients.text: List of whole plants (Apium graveolens L.)
ingredients.food: List of whole plants (Apium graveolens L.)

preparationDesc:
The fresh cottage cheese is beaten with the yogurt until a fluffy mixture is obtained. Add the cleaned, washed and finely chopped parsley, dill and celery leaves. The mixture is salted and mixed well. Serve chilled, garnished with parsley leaves.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Cottage cheese with green spices

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Beat the cottage cheese with the milk and the pureed red tomatoes until a fluffy mixture is obtained, then add the salt and finely chopped parsley. The mixture is mixed and served chilled, garnished with pieces of tomatoes and parsley leaves.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Cottage cheese with red tomatoes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Strawberries (raspberries, blackcurrants), after being cleaned and washed under abundant running water, are pureed. The juice separated from the fruit is kept cold in a non-oxidizing container (glass, strong enamel or stainless steel), and the rest of them is poured with hot water, boiled for a few minutes and filtered. The resulting liquid is allowed to boil and sugar and starch dissolved in a little cold water are added to it, with constant stirring, and after 1-2 minutes, the fruit and lemon juice are added. The prepared sour is stirred and stirred pour into bowls moistened with cold water and serve chilled.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, pickle is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Strawberry sour (raspberries, blackcurrants)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Apples (pears, quinces) are washed well and, together with the peel, cut into pieces, poured with hot water and boiled in a covered pot until completely soft, after which they are pureed. Sugar and starch dissolved in a little cold water are added to the resulting puree, with continuous stirring. The mixture is boiled for 1-2 minutes. Add the lemon juice. The finished pickle is stirred and poured into bowls moistened with cold water. It is served chilled.
Note. For diets No. 4 and 6, pears are not used to make pickles. Instead of sugar, the pickle can be sweetened with 20 g of honey. For diet No. 6, sour cream is sweetened with 8 g of sugar. Part of the fruit can be processed into juice, which is added to the finished sour.
title: Sour apples (pears, quinces)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The washed fruits are boiled until completely soft, after which the rest is done as for making sour apples.
title: Sour from dried rose hips (cranberries, dogwoods)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Juice is squeezed from the well-washed and cleaned fruits, which is stored in a non-oxidizing container in the cold. The rest of the fruit (the seed part and the husks) is poured with hot water and boiled for a few minutes. The decoction is filtered, sweetened with sugar, mixed with the acid and gelatin pre-soaked in a little cold water, heated again until boiling and cooled. The obtained fruit juice is added. The mixture is strained, poured into serving bowls, rinsed with cold water, and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the jelly, the bowls are dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Fresh fruit jelly

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
It is prepared like sour milk, with the difference that the fruit juice is added to the prepared sour milk, stirring with a wire.
Note. For diet No. 9, pickle is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Milk and fruit sour

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The drained fruits from the compote (the pits are removed from the cherries) are pureed (if necessary, they are boiled until completely soft before pureeing). The juice from the compote, sugar and water are added to the fruit puree, and after boiling, semolina is added in a thin stream and with constant stirring. The mixture is boiled for 5-6 minutes until it thickens and is beaten in a whisk (or with a wire) until a thick foam is formed.
Note. For diets No. 1 and 6, mousse is not prepared with apricots, for diets No. 8 and 9 it is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — without added sugar.
title: Sterilized fruit mousse with semolina

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Juice is squeezed from the well-washed and cleaned fruits, which is stored in a non-oxidizing container in the cold. The rest of the fruit (the seed part and the husks) is poured with hot water and boiled for a few minutes. The decoction is filtered, sweetened with sugar, mixed with the acid and gelatin pre-soaked in a little cold water, heated again until boiling and cooled. The obtained fruit juice is added. The mixture is strained, poured into serving bowls, rinsed with cold water, and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the jelly, the bowls are dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 8 g of sugar.
title: Fresh fruit jelly

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The washed and cleaned fruits are rubbed through a sieve. Sugar, pre-soaked gelatin in cold water and cream are added to the puree. The mixture is stirred, poured into serving bowls, rinsed with cold water, and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the jelly, the bowls are dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers.
Note. For diet No. 9, jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Strawberry jelly (raspberries) with cream (kaimak)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The washed and cleaned fruits are rubbed through a sieve. Sugar, pre-soaked gelatin in cold water and cream are added to the puree. The mixture is stirred, poured into serving bowls, rinsed with cold water, and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the jelly, the bowls are dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers.
Note. For diet No. 9, jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Strawberry jelly (raspberries) with cream (kaimak)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The gelatin is soaked in a little cold water (until it swells) and added to the boiling sweetened juice, which is then removed from the heat and stirred until the gelatin melts, strained and poured into bowls rinsed with cold water and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the prepared jelly, the bowls are dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, the jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 5 g of sugar.
title: Jelly from sterilized natural juice

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Zucchini, carrots and celery, cut into pieces, are boiled in salted water until soft. Add the chopped peppers and parsley and some of the pureed tomatoes. The mixture is poured into a tray and poured with the rest of the pureed tomatoes, the flour dissolved in a little cold water and the fat. Slices of lemon are placed on top. The dish is baked in a moderate oven. It is served cold.
title: Plakia after garden

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is boned, cut into pieces and poured with cold water over high heat to boil quickly, skimmed, salted and left to boil over low heat. When the meat softens, add the carrots and white roots, cut into small cubes or grated. Fifteen to twenty minutes before removing the soup from the heat, add the rice and tomatoes, mashed or peeled and chopped into small pieces. After the rice is softened, a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and eggs is added. The finished soup is seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 6, 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt. The amount of rice for diets No. 8, 9 is reduced to 3 g. The soup is not salted for diets No. 7, 8, 10. For diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Beef soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned chicken is washed and cut into pieces, covered with cold water and left on high heat. Before boiling the water, remove the foam and add salt and chopped carrots and white roots (it is preferable to take parsley or parsnip roots). When the meat softens, add the cleaned and washed rice. The soup is brought to a boil, built up with a boiled structure of yogurt, toasted flour and eggs, seasoned with butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and a slice of lemon.
Note: For diets No. 6, 8, the soup can be prepared without salt, lemon and fat. The amount of rice for diets No. 8, 9 is reduced to 3 g. The soup is not salted for diets No. 7, 8, 10. For diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Chicken soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned chicken is washed and cut into pieces, covered with cold water and left on high heat. Before boiling the water, remove the foam and add salt and chopped carrots and white roots (it is preferable to take parsley or parsnip roots). When the meat softens, add the cleaned and washed rice. The soup is brought to a boil, built up with a boiled structure of yogurt, toasted flour and eggs, seasoned with butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and a slice of lemon.
Note: For diets No. 6, 8, the soup can be prepared without salt, lemon and fat. The amount of rice for diets No. 8, 9 is reduced to 3 g. The soup is not salted for diets No. 7, 8, 10. For diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Chicken soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is washed, cut into pieces, placed in a pot of cold water over high heat. Before boiling, the broth is skimmed off, then salted and left to boil over low heat together with carrots and white roots, cleaned, washed and chopped. When the meat is almost cooked, add the rice, red tomatoes and onion. The soup is brought to a boil, topped with a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and eggs, seasoned with fresh butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand. With diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed. In diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, onions can be added.
title: Lamb soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The boneless meat is cut into small pieces, placed in a pot of cold water over high heat and brought to a rapid boil. The foam is removed and the meat is boiled until tender. The salt, the potatoes cut into cubes, the washed rice, the chopped peppers, tomatoes and carrots are added successively. Pour the beaten egg through a colander into the finished soup and mix. The soup is left to boil for another 5-10 minutes, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: The amount of rice for diets No. 8, 9 is reduced to 3 g. The soup for diets No. 7, 8, 10 is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand. For diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Country style soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The gelatin is soaked in a little cold water (until it swells) and added to the boiling sweetened juice, which is then removed from the heat and stirred until the gelatin melts, strained and poured into bowls rinsed with cold water and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the prepared jelly, the bowls are dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, the jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 5 g of sugar.
title: Jelly from sterilized natural juice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Gelatin is soaked in cold water to swell. The fruit is drained of the juice, which is then mixed with water and sugar, boiled and removed from the heat, mixed with gelatin, strained and cooled, poured into serving bowls, previously rinsed with cold water, and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the prepared jelly, the bowls are placed for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers. The compote fruit is used to prepare fruit salads, pickles, mousses, etc.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Sterilized fruit jelly

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Green beans, cut lengthwise, are boiled in lightly salted water until tender, along with diced carrots and celery. Add the coarsely chopped tomatoes. Pour the mixture into a pan and cover with the flour dissolved in cold water and the fat. Slices of lemon are placed on top. The dish is baked in a moderate oven. Serve cold, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Green bean casserole

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Cleaned, washed and diced carrots and celery are stewed in fat and a little water until soft. Zucchini and tomatoes are cut into slices and mixed with the stewed root vegetables. The mixture is poured into a tray, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and poured with the flour dissolved in cold water. Slices of lemon are placed on top. The dish is baked in a moderate oven
title: Zucchini plate

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is washed, cut into pieces, placed in a pot of cold water over high heat. Before boiling, the broth is skimmed off, then salted and left to boil over low heat together with carrots and white roots, cleaned, washed and chopped. When the meat is almost cooked, add the rice, red tomatoes and onion. The soup is brought to a boil, topped with a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and eggs, seasoned with fresh butter and served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand. With diet No. 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed. In diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, onions can be added.
title: Lamb soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Boneless, washed and cut into small pieces of meat is placed in a container of cold water and boiled over low heat. After removing the foam, add the salt, carrots and white roots, chopped or grated. As soon as the meat and roots are soft, add the diced potatoes and the red tomatoes, peeled and chopped or pureed. The finished soup is built up with a boiled build-up of the egg and yogurt, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note: For diets No. 6, 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt. At the discretion of the dietician, the soup can be prepared without any seasoning. For diets No. 7, 8, 9, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand. For diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Beef and potato soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The washed and cleaned fruits are rubbed through a sieve. Sugar, pre-soaked gelatin in cold water and cream are added to the puree. The mixture is stirred, poured into serving bowls, rinsed with cold water, and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the jelly, the bowls are dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers.
Note. For diet No. 9, jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Strawberry jelly (raspberries) with cream (kaimak)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Gelatin is soaked in cold water to swell. The fruit is drained of the juice, which is then mixed with water and sugar, boiled and removed from the heat, mixed with gelatin, strained and cooled, poured into serving bowls, previously rinsed with cold water, and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the prepared jelly, the bowls are placed for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers. The compote fruit is used to prepare fruit salads, pickles, mousses, etc.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Sterilized fruit jelly

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:

title: Sterilized fruit jelly

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Zucchini, carrots and celery, cut into pieces, are boiled in salted water until soft. Add the chopped peppers and parsley and some of the pureed tomatoes. The mixture is poured into a tray and poured with the rest of the pureed tomatoes, the flour dissolved in a little cold water and the fat. Slices of lemon are placed on top. The dish is baked in a moderate oven. It is served cold.
title: Plakia after garden

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is boned, cut into pieces and poured with cold water over high heat to boil quickly, skimmed, salted and left to boil over low heat. When the meat softens, add the carrots and white roots, cut into small cubes or grated. Fifteen to twenty minutes before removing the soup from the heat, add the rice and tomatoes, mashed or peeled and chopped into small pieces. After the rice is softened, a boiled mixture of yogurt, toasted flour and eggs is added. The finished soup is seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 6, 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt. The amount of rice for diets No. 8, 9 is reduced to 3 g. The soup is not salted for diets No. 7, 8, 10. For diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Beef soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is ground in a meat grinder with a thick grid, mixed well with salt and part of the eggs, rice and finely chopped parsley and left to stand, after which it is formed into small balls (4-5 pieces per portion) with hands wetted with water. Place the chopped root vegetables in boiling salted water and cook until soft. Add the meatballs, the rest of the rice and finally the peeled and chopped tomatoes. The soup is brought to a boil, it is built up with a boiled structure of yogurt, toasted flour and the rest of the eggs, seasoned with the fresh butter and sprinkled with the rest of the finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 6, 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt. The amount of rice for diets No. 8, 9 is reduced to 3 g. The soup is not salted for diets No. 7, 8, 10. For diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Soup with beef balls

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
