title: Soup with beef balls

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The boneless meat is cut into small pieces, placed in a pot of cold water over high heat and brought to a rapid boil. The foam is removed and the meat is boiled until tender. The salt, the potatoes cut into cubes, the washed rice, the chopped peppers, tomatoes and carrots are added successively. Pour the beaten egg through a colander into the finished soup and mix. The soup is left to boil for another 5-10 minutes, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: The amount of rice for diets No. 8, 9 is reduced to 3 g. The soup for diets No. 7, 8, 10 is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand. For diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Country style soup

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The gelatin is soaked in a little cold water (until it swells) and added to the boiling sweetened juice, which is then removed from the heat and stirred until the gelatin melts, strained and poured into bowls rinsed with cold water and left to gel in the cold. Before serving the prepared jelly, the bowls are dipped for 1-2 seconds in hot water and turned into saucers.
Note. For diets No. 8 and 9, the jelly is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener, and for diet No. 6 — with 5 g of sugar.
title: Jelly from sterilized natural juice

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Green beans, cut lengthwise, are boiled in lightly salted water until tender, along with diced carrots and celery. Add the coarsely chopped tomatoes. Pour the mixture into a pan and cover with the flour dissolved in cold water and the fat. Slices of lemon are placed on top. The dish is baked in a moderate oven. Serve cold, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Green bean casserole

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Cleaned, washed and diced carrots and celery are stewed in fat and a little water until soft. Zucchini and tomatoes are cut into slices and mixed with the stewed root vegetables. The mixture is poured into a tray, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and poured with the flour dissolved in cold water. Slices of lemon are placed on top. The dish is baked in a moderate oven
title: Zucchini plate

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: After they are cleaned and washed, the cauliflower is broken into branches, and the carrots and celery are cut into cubes. They are boiled separately in slightly salted water, poured into a tray and mixed with the pureed tomatoes. The mixture is poured with the flour diluted with cold water and the fat and sprinkled with the chopped parsley. Slices of lemon are placed on top. The dish is baked in a moderate oven.
title: Cauliflower plate

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: The okra is carefully cleaned, removing the stalks without opening the cups so that they do not tear during cooking, rub lightly with salt, rinse and stew in fat and a little water, cover with hot water and boil over low heat until soft. Towards the end, add the mashed tomatoes and the toasted flour dissolved in cold water. Before serving, the dish is sprinkled with chopped parsley.
title: Okra stew

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: The cleaned and well-washed peas are boiled until softened and the fat, mashed tomatoes and flour dissolved in cold water are added to it. The dish is salted and cooked over low heat, sprinkled with finely chopped dill and served with yogurt.
title: Pea stew

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions and lightly stewed in a part of the oil and a little water, salted, poured with hot water and left to boil over low heat until almost tender. Add the cleaned, washed arpajik, lightly stewed in the rest of the oil and a little water, the red pepper, the peeled and coarsely chopped tomatoes (garlic) and finally the flour dissolved in cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat in a tightly closed vessel. After removing it from the fire, sprinkle it with finely chopped parsley.
title: Chicken pop stew

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, poured with a little water and left to boil on low heat until semi-soft. The diced or spoon-shaped carrots and celery, lightly stewed in butter and a little water, the diced or spoon-shaped potatoes, the peeled and finely chopped or pureed tomatoes are successively added. The dish is salted and boiled until ready on low heat, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 6 it can be prepared with 5 g of vegetable oil, without salt.
title: Chicken ragout

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned, cleaned of the skins and tendons and washed, cut into portions, put in hot water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then taken out and drained, poured with hot water (in a ratio of 3:1 with rice), salted and left to boil over low heat. Add the oil and the cleaned and washed rice. The dish is stirred and baked in a moderate oven until the rice swells and no liquid remains. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10 — the dish is prepared without salt. The dish can also be prepared with pureed red tomatoes (60 g fresh or 50 g sterilized), increasing the yield per serving to 300 g. For diet No. 6, the dish can be prepared with 5 g of rast. butter and no salt.
title: Beef with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The rabbit meat is cleaned and washed, cut into portions and placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat. Finely chopped and slightly stewed carrots in a little water and part of the oil, cleaned and washed rice, raisins (mushrooms) are gradually added, after which the dish is baked in a moderate oven until no liquid remains. Finally, add the rest of the oil. Before serving, the dish is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 10, 11, 15, raisins can be replaced with mushrooms.
title: Domestic rabbit meat with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned and cleaned of skin and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in a pot of warm water and boiled for a few minutes. Take it out, put it in hot water, add salt and cook it on a low heat until soft together with the fat (and finely chopped onion). Add the potatoes, peeled and cut into large, equally sized pieces, and after ten minutes, the peeled and coarsely chopped tomatoes and the flour dissolved in a little water. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Served with finely chopped parsley (fennel).
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 10, 11, 15, it can be prepared with onions. Toasted flour is provided for a dish made with new potatoes. For diets No. 6, the dish can be prepared with 5 g of rast. butter, no salt.
title: Beef with potatoes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The meat is boned, cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed, cut into portioned pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water and allowed to boil over low heat until semi-soft along with some of the fat. The cabbage is washed with cold water, cut into small pieces and stewed in the remaining fat, mixed with red pepper and poured over the meat. The dish is covered with a little hot water or broth and baked in a moderate oven until it remains in the fat.
title: Beef with sauerkraut

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and left to boil over low heat until softened together with part of the butter. In the remaining fat and a little water, the finely chopped onion is stewed and the finely chopped carrots and the mushrooms cut into strips are added. The stewed vegetables are added to the meat, then the mashed tomatoes are added and finally the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven and served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Veal with mushrooms

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cooled butter is mixed with 1/4 of the total amount of sifted flour, rolled into a small square and left in the refrigerator. The remaining flour is formed into a pile with a depression (well) in the middle, where the salt and acid are put and the water is gradually poured. Knead the dough, first working with a knife, then with your hands, and knead for 10-15 minutes until smooth, shiny and dry. Shape it into a ball, cut the top into squares and leave it for 1/2 hour in the cold, until its hardness becomes like that of a butter square. It is then rolled out into a larger square with a thickness of about 0.75 cm. Place the butter square diagonally in the middle and remove the stuck flour with a brush. The edges of the dough square are folded over the butter in the form of an envelope and pressed. The resulting square is turned over and rolled into a rectangle by gently pressing and rolling the rolling pin. The rectangle is folded 3 times lengthwise and 3 times widthwise, covered with a damp cloth and left for about 1/2 hour in the cold, then again rolled into a rectangle, folded 3 times lengthwise and 3 times in width, covered with a damp cloth and left to rest for 1/2 hour in the cold. This is repeated 1-2 more times.
The matured dough is rolled out into a 4-5 mm thick crust and cut into squares with a side of 7-8 cm. In the middle of each square is placed a part of the filling made from peeled and sliced ​​or cubed apples, stewed with sugar until the liquid evaporates. The squares with the stuffing are folded into rectangles or triangles. The prepared pies are placed in a tray moistened with water and baked in a preheated oven, and after baking they are sprinkled with powdered sugar.
Note: For diet No. 9, the pies are prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener. Only 1/2 portion is given.
The ingredients are presented sequentially - first for the dough and then for the filling.
title: Pies with apples

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Multi-leaf dough is prepared as for pies with apples - rec. No. 665 (to make the boards more fragile, 10% of the intended amount of oil can be put into the main dough). It is left to age and rolled into a 4-5 mm thick crust, which is cut into 2 plates with a width of 6-7 cm. The plates are pierced with a fork, placed in a tray moistened with water, and baked in a preheated oven. One board is smeared on the front side with the previously prepared cream. The other board is cut with a sharp knife into squares, which are placed on top of the cream face down. After that, the bottom board is also cut along the outlined squares of the top board and the crempita is sprinkled with powdered sugar.
Preparation of the cream. Eggs beaten with starch and part of the cold milk, previously separated, are added to the boiling milk, sweetened with sugar, with continuous stirring. Boil the mixture for 1-2 minutes and cool, stirring, then add the butter (in crumbs) and vanilla.
Note: The products for the dough and for the cream are given sequentially.
When using guaranteed eggs, the whites are beaten to snow with part of the sugar and added to the cooked cream. For diet No. 9, the crepes are prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Krempita with vanilla cream

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat, cut into pieces, is put to boil. The red beetroot, cut into straws, is stewed until softened in a part of the butter together with the sugar and a part of the pureed tomatoes (vinegar). The chopped carrots and white roots are added to the semi-cooked meat, then the cabbage, cut into strips, the stewed beetroot and the remaining pureed tomatoes are successively added. When serving the borscht, put unbeaten yogurt (cream) on the plates and sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand. For diet No. 10, V2 portion of soup may be given.
title: Borscht with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, which are lightly stewed (together with the finely chopped onion) in a part of the oil and a little water. The red pepper is added, then the meat is salted, covered with hot water and left to boil over low heat. Peppers are cleaned from the stalks and seeds, washed, cut into medium-sized uniform pieces, lightly stewed in the remaining oil and a little water and added to the semi-softened meat. After that, the peeled and sliced ​​tomatoes and the toasted flour, previously diluted with cold water, are successively added. The dish is baked in a moderate oven and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley. Sterilized paprika is added to the dish when the meat is already soft.
Note: For diets N 7, 8, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 8 it can be prepared with 5 g of butter. For diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, the dish can be prepared with sweet red pepper and onions.
title: Chicken stew

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, which are placed in a container with a little warm water and stewed over low heat. The vegetables are washed, cut and successively (according to their firmness) lightly stewed in oil and a little water, then added to the meat. Add the salt and the washed and cut potatoes, then the peeled and chopped tomatoes. The dish is left to boil on a low heat until the meat and vegetables are completely softened, and finally it is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 8, the dish can be prepared with 5 g of butter. For diet No. 5, the dish is prepared without peas, and the yield is accordingly reduced to 280 g.
title: Chicken with vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken (or lean turkey) is cleaned, washed and cut into portions, which are lightly stewed (along with finely chopped onions) in oil and a little water. Add (red pepper) and hot water, add salt and cook over low heat until semi-soft. Add the cleaned, washed and sliced ​​fresh cabbage (lightly rubbed with the remaining salt for diets #9, 11, 15), and then the peeled and chopped tomatoes. The dish is placed in a moderate oven and baked until almost only the fat remains. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley. Cabbage can be pre-steamed in some butter and a little water and then added to the meat.
Note: For diets #7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets #9, 10, 11, 15, it can be prepared with onions and sweet red pepper.

Then it is taken out and placed in hot water, salted and, together with the butter and finely chopped onion, left to boil over low heat until semi-soft. The cleaned, washed and chopped green beans are successively added (the sterilized green beans are added to the already softened meat), the peeled and chopped or pureed red tomatoes and finally the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water. title: Beef with green beans

preparationDesc:
The meat (veal is pre-boned) is cleaned of sinews, washed, cut into portioned pieces and put in hot water to boil for a few minutes, then put in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat with some of the butter. Peppers are cleaned of stems and seeds, washed, cut into medium-sized equal pieces, lightly stewed in the remaining oil and a little water and added to the softened meat. title: Veal popsicle stew

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
They are prepared according to the recipe. Eclairs, but filled with cream made from cottage cheese (if necessary, it is pureed), grated lemon peel, vanilla and the sweetener - saccharin.
Note: The products for the dough and for the filling are listed sequentially. Instead of cottage cheese, eclairs can be prepared with 30 g of cheese, reducing the yield by 20 g.
The ingredients are listed first for the dough and then for the filling.
title: Eclairs with curd cream (cheese)

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: You cut the banana into pieces and spread them with peanut butter.
title: Banana with peanut butter

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
A multi-leaf dough is prepared, as for pies (rec. 665). It is left to age, rolled into a crust 4-5 mm thick and cut into strips 8-10 cm wide. In the middle of each strip lengthwise, a part of the previously prepared stuffing is placed (sugar and breadcrumbs are added to the peeled and coarsely grated apples, or pitted cherries, or finely chopped peaches or apricots). One end of the strip is folded over the filling and brushed with the beaten egg, then the other end of the strip is folded over it. The shaped rolls are placed in a tray moistened with water, spread with the rest of the beaten egg and baked. Cut the baked strudel into portions with a sharp knife and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Note: The products for the dough and for the filling are listed sequentially.
For diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, cinnamon (0.2 g) can be added to the apple filling. When using sterilized fruit, the sugar is reduced to 5 g. For diet No. 9, the strudel is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Shrudel from multi-leaved dough with fruit

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Boneless, washed and cut into small pieces of meat is placed in a container of cold water and boiled over low heat. After removing the foam, add the salt, carrots and white roots, chopped or grated. As soon as the meat and roots are soft, add the diced potatoes and the red tomatoes, peeled and chopped or pureed. The finished soup is built up with a boiled build-up of the egg and yogurt, seasoned with butter and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note: For diets No. 6, 8, the soup can be prepared without fat and salt. At the discretion of the dietician, the soup can be prepared without any seasoning. For diets No. 7, 8, 9, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand. For diets No. 8, 10, 1/2 portion of soup can be relaxed.
title: Beef and potato soup

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: The cleaned and well-washed peas are boiled until softened and the fat, mashed tomatoes and flour dissolved in cold water are added to it. The dish is salted and cooked over low heat, sprinkled with finely chopped dill and served with yogurt.
title: Pea stew

Cleaned, washed and cut into portions, the chicken is lightly stewed in butter and a little water together with finely chopped onions and coarsely grated carrots and celery, then it is poured with hot water, salted and left to boil over low heat until semi-soft. Add the cleaned, washed and sliced ​​fresh mushrooms, then the pureed tomatoes and toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water. The finished dish is served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.

The finely chopped onion is lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water. The well-cleaned and washed spinach, roughly chopped, is added and also stewed. The stewed vegetable is added to the softened meat. After a few minutes, add the mashed tomatoes and the toasted flour dissolved in cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat. It is served with yogurt.
title: Beef with spinach

author: Rihanna Angelova

The meat (the veal is deboned) is cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed, cut into portioned pieces, put in hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then taken out, put in hot water, salted and left to boil over low heat together with some of the fat.

When the meat is soft, add the peeled, washed and cut into equal pieces of potatoes, and then the peeled and coarsely chopped tomatoes. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in the oven. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.

title: Veal with mushrooms

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
They are prepared according to the recipe. Eclairs, but filled with cream made from cottage cheese (if necessary, it is pureed), grated lemon peel, vanilla and the sweetener - saccharin.
Note: The dough and cream products are listed sequentially. Instead of cottage cheese, eclairs can be prepared with 30 g of cheese, reducing the yield by 20 g.
The ingredients are listed first for the dough and then for the filling.
title: Eclairs with curd cream (cheese)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Multi-leaf dough is prepared as for pies with apples - rec. No. 665 (to make the boards more fragile, 10% of the intended amount of oil can be put into the main dough). It is left to age and rolled into a 4-5 mm thick crust, which is cut into 2 plates with a width of 6-7 cm. The plates are pierced with a fork, placed in a tray moistened with water, and baked in a preheated oven. One board is smeared on the front side with the previously prepared cream. The other board is cut with a sharp knife into squares, which are placed on top of the cream face down. After that, the bottom board is also cut along the outlined squares of the top board and the crempita is sprinkled with powdered sugar.
Preparation of the cream. Eggs beaten with starch and part of the cold milk, previously separated, are added to the boiling milk, sweetened with sugar, with continuous stirring. Boil the mixture for 1-2 minutes and cool, stirring, then add the butter (in crumbs) and vanilla.
Note: The products for the dough and for the filling are listed sequentially.
When using guaranteed eggs, the whites are beaten to snow with part of the sugar and added to the cooked cream. For diet No. 9, the crepes are prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Krempita with vanilla cream

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
A multi-leaf dough is prepared, as for pies (rec. 665). It is left to age, rolled into a crust 4-5 mm thick and cut into strips 8-10 cm wide. In the middle of each strip lengthwise, a part of the previously prepared stuffing is placed (sugar and breadcrumbs are added to the peeled and coarsely grated apples, or pitted cherries, or finely chopped peaches or apricots). One end of the strip is folded over the filling and brushed with the beaten egg, then the other end of the strip is folded over it. The shaped rolls are placed in a tray moistened with water, spread with the rest of the beaten egg and baked. Cut the baked strudel into portions with a sharp knife and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Note: The products for the dough and for the filling are listed sequentially.
For diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, cinnamon (0.2 g) can be added to the apple filling. When using sterilized fruit, the sugar is reduced to 5 g. For diet No. 9, the strudel is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Shrudel from multi-leaved dough with fruit

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat, cut into pieces, is put to boil. The red beetroot, cut into straws, is stewed until softened in a part of the butter together with the sugar and a part of the pureed tomatoes (vinegar). The chopped carrots and white roots are added to the semi-cooked meat, then the cabbage, cut into strips, the stewed beetroot and the remaining pureed tomatoes are successively added. When serving the borscht, put unbeaten yogurt (cream) on the plates and sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the soup is not salted. At the doctor's discretion, a certain amount of salt is given by hand. For diet No. 10, V2 portion of soup may be given.
title: Borscht with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, which are lightly stewed (together with the finely chopped onion) in a part of the oil and a little water. The red pepper is added, then the meat is salted, covered with hot water and left to boil over low heat. Peppers are cleaned from the stalks and seeds, washed, cut into medium-sized uniform pieces, lightly stewed in the remaining oil and a little water and added to the semi-softened meat. After that, the peeled and sliced ​​tomatoes and the toasted flour, previously diluted with cold water, are successively added. The dish is baked in a moderate oven and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley. Sterilized paprika is added to the dish when the meat is already soft.
Note: For diets N 7, 8, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 8 it can be prepared with 5 g of butter. For diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, the dish can be prepared with sweet red pepper and onions.
title: Chicken stew

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, which are placed in a container with a little warm water and stewed over low heat. The vegetables are washed, cut and successively (according to their firmness) lightly stewed in oil and a little water, then added to the meat. Add the salt and the washed and cut potatoes, then the peeled and chopped tomatoes. The dish is left to boil on a low heat until the meat and vegetables are completely softened, and finally it is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 8, the dish can be prepared with 5 g of butter. For diet No. 5, the dish is prepared without peas, and the yield is accordingly reduced to 280 g.
title: Chicken with vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned, cleaned of the skins and tendons and washed, cut into portions, put in hot water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then taken out and drained, poured with hot water (in a ratio of 3:1 with rice), salted and left to boil over low heat. Add the oil and the cleaned and washed rice. The dish is stirred and baked in a moderate oven until the rice swells and no liquid remains. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10 — the dish is prepared without salt. The dish can also be prepared with pureed red tomatoes (60 g fresh or 50 g sterilized), increasing the yield per serving to 300 g. For diet No. 6, the dish can be prepared with 5 g of rast. butter and no salt.
title: Beef with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The rabbit meat is cleaned and washed, cut into portions and placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat. Finely chopped and slightly stewed carrots in a little water and part of the oil, cleaned and washed rice, raisins (mushrooms) are gradually added, after which the dish is baked in a moderate oven until no liquid remains. Finally, add the rest of the oil. Before serving, the dish is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 10, 11, 15, raisins can be replaced with mushrooms.
title: Domestic rabbit meat with rice

author: Rihanna Angelova

Take it out, put it in hot water, add salt and cook it on a low heat until soft together with the fat (and finely chopped onion). Add the potatoes, peeled and cut into large, equally sized pieces, and after ten minutes, the peeled and coarsely chopped tomatoes and the flour dissolved in a little water. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Served with finely chopped parsley (fennel).
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 10, 11, 15, it can be prepared with onions. Toasted flour is provided for a dish made with new potatoes. For diets No. 6, the dish can be prepared with 5 g of rast. butter, no salt.
title: Beef with potatoes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The meat (the veal is deboned) is cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed, cut into portioned pieces, put in hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then taken out, put in hot water and, together with some of the fat, boiled over low heat until softened. The finely chopped onion is lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water. The well-cleaned and washed spinach, roughly chopped, is added and also stewed. The stewed vegetable is added to the softened meat. After a few minutes, add the mashed tomatoes and the toasted flour dissolved in cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat. It is served with yogurt.
title: Beef with spinach

author: Rihanna Angelova

When the meat is soft, add the peeled, washed and cut into equal pieces of potatoes, and then the peeled and coarsely chopped tomatoes. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in the oven. author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cooled butter is mixed with 1/4 of the total amount of sifted flour, rolled into a small square and left in the refrigerator. The remaining flour is formed into a pile with a depression (well) in the middle, where the salt and acid are put and the water is gradually poured. Knead the dough, first working with a knife, then with your hands, and knead for 10-15 minutes until smooth, shiny and dry. Shape it into a ball, cut the top into squares and leave it for 1/2 hour in the cold, until its hardness becomes like that of a butter square. It is then rolled out into a larger square with a thickness of about 0.75 cm. Place the butter square diagonally in the middle and remove the stuck flour with a brush. The edges of the dough square are folded over the butter in the form of an envelope and pressed. The resulting square is turned over and rolled into a rectangle by gently pressing and rolling the rolling pin. The rectangle is folded 3 times lengthwise and 3 times widthwise, covered with a damp cloth and left for about 1/2 hour in the cold, then again rolled into a rectangle, folded 3 times lengthwise and 3 times in width, covered with a damp cloth and left to rest for 1/2 hour in the cold. This is repeated 1-2 more times.
The matured dough is rolled out into a 4-5 mm thick crust and cut into squares with a side of 7-8 cm. In the middle of each square is placed a part of the filling made from peeled and sliced ​​or cubed apples, stewed with sugar until the liquid evaporates. The squares with the stuffing are folded into rectangles or triangles. The prepared pies are placed in a tray moistened with water and baked in a preheated oven, and after baking they are sprinkled with powdered sugar.
Note: The products for the dough and for the filling are listed sequentially. For diet No. 9, pies are prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener. Only 1/2 portion is given.

eggs are separated into whites and yolks. Beat the egg whites until stiff, add a little sweetener, baking powder and vanilla. beat the yolks with a whisk until white. They are mixed carefully with a spatula by hand so that the air does not fall out. The bran is ground to a fine flour and added to the eggs by folding again. The mixture is spread evenly on a silicone mat and baked for 20 minutes at 160 degrees. While it cools down, prepare the coffee
Fresh milk is added to the curd and mashed until smooth, to obtain the so-called Zona whipped cream. Add the other petmez cheese and vanilla. 
A little petmez and rum is added to the warm coffee. The cooled marshmallow is divided into 2, one half is placed in a suitable container and poured with half of the coffee. Sprinkle with some of the ground almonds and spread with half of the cream. Everything is repeated once more and poured with the rest of the coffee, finally sprinkled with the cocoa through a strainer.

Add the beaten egg whites, cauliflower and salt. The mixture is lightly mixed with flour or breadcrumbs, poured into a greased pan, sprinkled with the remaining cheese and fat and baked in a moderate oven.
title: Cauliflower pudding

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Cauliflower is cleaned and washed, cut into branches and boiled in slightly salted water until soft. Beat the yolks with the milk and mix with 1/2 of the coarsely grated cheese. title: Cauliflower pudding

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
Zucchini are peeled, washed and cut into slices. They are salted, rolled in flour and fried in hot fat. They are arranged on a plate, covered with tomato or milk sauce and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.

Preparation of the milk sauce. 

Yogurt is whipped and to
ground walnuts and vegetable oil are added to it.
Zucchini can be served with 110 g of yogurt instead of
milk sauce.

If the dish is prepared with peppers, they are pre-roasted, peeled
are and cleaned from the stalks and seeds.
title: Fried zucchini (peppers) with sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Cleaned, washed and cut into portions, the chicken is placed in a container with a little water, salted and boiled over low heat until soft, together with chopped carrots and celery. The meat is then removed, the broth is strained, and the carrots and celery are pureed. From the pureed vegetables, the toasted flour dissolved in a little water and part of the broth, a sauce is prepared by whipping it with a wire, and the cooked meat is added to it. The dish is left to boil for a few minutes on low heat, seasoned with lemon juice and fresh oil and served.
Note: For diets #7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet #6, it can be prepared with 5 g of vegetable oil, without lemon and without salt.
title: Chicken with white sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, poured with cold water and brought to a boil over high heat, then skimmed, salted and boiled over low heat until soft together with carrots and white roots. The toasted flour is diluted with the chicken broth and the porridge is boiled over low heat, stirring with a wire. Finally, the fresh butter is added. Boiled meat is poured with the porridge.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 7, 10, 13, 15, the flour can be lightly fried.
title: Chicken porridge

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: A soft dough is kneaded, soft balls are formed and fried.
title: Meccas

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The peppers cleaned of seeds are washed and cut into strips. Mashed tomatoes, rice, salt, fat and hot water are added to them. The dish is baked in an oven. It is served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and salad depending on the season and the diet of the patient.
title: Peppers with rice — baked

author: Ralitsa Ralitsa
preparationDesc:
Everything is blended or pureed. They are baked on medium because they rise quickly. 
Garnished with cream cheese + ham for 0.5 BP and fruit for dessert separately for 0.5 BV
title: Spinach pancakes with cream cheese and ham

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Washed apples are peeled, seeded, cut into thin slices and mixed with washed and cleaned strawberries and raspberries. The fruits are poured with the previously drained yogurt, sweetened with sugar, flavored with vanilla and beaten with wire. The salad is mixed, cooled and then served.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 9, the salad is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Fruit salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Yogurt is placed in cheesecloth and drained from the whey. Drained and diced peaches are added to the cleaned and washed strawberries. The fruits are poured with the drained yogurt, sweetened with sugar and flavored with vanilla, and mixed. The salad is served well chilled.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 9, the salad is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Spring fruit salad

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
A syrup is made from the water, sugar and lemon.
Pears are peeled and seeded, and apricots and peaches are pitted. They are cut into cubes, mixed and poured with the cooled syrup. The salad is served well chilled.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 9, the salad is prepared without sugar or with artificial sweetener.
title: Summer fruit salad—I option

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: Yogurt is placed in cheesecloth (cheesecloth), drained from the whey (the cream is cooled) and beaten together with sugar. The washed pears are peeled, cleaned of the seed part and cut into cubes together with the watermelon separated from the skin. Add the crushed grape seeds. The fruits are mixed and poured with the yogurt flavored with vanilla. The salad is served well chilled.
title: Autumn fruit salad with yogurt

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Peeled apples are cleaned from the seed part, cut into thin slices and immediately sprinkled with lemon juice. Add the peeled bananas, cut into rings, and the oranges, cut into cubes. The fruits are sprinkled with sugar and mixed. The salad is served well chilled.
Note: For diets No. 1 and 4, the salad is prepared with soft varieties of apples.
title: Fruit salad with southern fruits

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
Zucchini are scraped and hollowed out to a thickness of 7-10 mm. The tomatoes are pureed and the fat and hot water are added to them, and when they boil, the rice is added. The mixture is boiled until the rice swells, salted and mixed with finely chopped dill (parsley). Zucchini are filled with it. They are arranged in a tray, covered with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. They are covered with a sauce made from the flour, eggs and milk, and wiped out. They can also be submitted
without sauce (only with yogurt). The inside of the zucchini, finely chopped and stewed together with the rice, can be added to the filling.
title: Zucchini stuffed with rice

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The mushrooms are cleaned and washed, cut into pieces and stewed in the fat and a little water until soft, then the rice, mashed tomatoes and salt are added. The dish is cooked over low heat. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Mushrooms with rice

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The mushrooms are cleaned and washed, cut into pieces and stewed in the fat and a little water until soft, then the rice, mashed tomatoes and salt are added. The dish is cooked over low heat. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Mushrooms with rice

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The rice is boiled behind with the fat in salted water until swollen. Beat the curd well and mix with the rice. Add the eggs and sugar. The mixture is stirred, poured into a pan greased with butter, and baked in a moderate oven until golden brown. The mixture can be poured into individual bowls and baked in a water bath.
title: Cottage cheese and rice pudding

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The rice is boiled behind with the fat in salted water until swollen. Beat the curd well and mix with the rice. Add the eggs and sugar. The mixture is stirred, poured into a pan greased with butter, and baked in a moderate oven until golden brown. The mixture can be poured into individual bowls and baked in a water bath.
title: Cottage cheese and rice pudding

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Potatoes are boiled, peeled and grated. Add the egg yolks beaten with milk and salt, half of the cheese (grated), the egg whites beaten to snow and the flour. The mixture is stirred and poured into a greased pan, sprinkled with the remaining cheese and fat and baked in a moderate oven.
title: Potato pudding

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Potatoes are boiled, peeled and grated. Add the egg yolks beaten with milk and salt, half of the cheese (grated), the egg whites beaten to snow and the flour. The mixture is stirred and poured into a greased pan, sprinkled with the remaining cheese and fat and baked in a moderate oven.
title: Potato pudding

title: Potato pudding

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
Peeled and washed zucchini are cut into cubes, salted and stewed in a part of the fat and a little water. Add the beaten eggs, milk and 1/2 of the cheese to them. The mixture is salted and mixed, poured into a tray or into individual molds greased with fat, sprinkled with the remaining amount of crumbled cheese and fat
and bake in a moderate oven.
title: Zucchini pudding

Pour the pureed tomatoes into the same fat and cook together with sugar and salt until thickened. Pour the prepared tomato sauce over the peppers, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve.
title: Fried peppers with tomato sauce

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Peppers are cleaned from the stalks, washed, dried, fried in hot fat and arranged on a plate. Pour the pureed tomatoes into the same fat and cook together with sugar and salt until thickened. Pour the prepared tomato sauce over the peppers, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve.
title: Fried peppers with tomato sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions and boiled in a small amount of salted water. The cleaned and washed peas are boiled separately, mashed and mixed with the mashed tomatoes, toasted flour dissolved in cold water (broth) and part of the chicken broth. It is prepared by whisking a smooth sauce into which the cooked meat is placed and fresh oil is added. After boiling for a few minutes on low heat, the dish is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley (fennel) and served.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Chicken with pea sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned and washed, cut into portions, covered with a little water, salted and left to boil over low heat until the meat is soft. Peppers are washed and cleaned of seeds and stalks, washed again, cut, boiled and pureed. To them are added the pureed tomatoes, the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water and the broth from cooking the chicken. A sauce is prepared, which is whisked over the fire until it becomes smooth and thickens as needed. Add the cooked meat and fresh butter to the sauce. The dish is left to boil for a few minutes on low heat, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Chicken with pepper sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned and washed, cut into portions, covered with a little water, salted and left to boil over low heat until the meat is soft. Peppers are washed and cleaned of seeds and stalks, washed again, cut, boiled and pureed. To them are added the pureed tomatoes, the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water and the broth from cooking the chicken. A sauce is prepared, which is whisked over the fire until it becomes smooth and thickens as needed. Add the cooked meat and fresh butter to the sauce. The dish is left to boil for a few minutes on low heat, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Chicken with pepper sauce

preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed bird is deboned and the meat is cut into pieces (4-5 pieces per portion). Carrots are cleaned and washed, grated on a fine grater and lightly stewed together with the meat in oil and a little water. Add the pureed tomatoes and a little hot water. The dish is salted and stewed in a tightly closed vessel over low heat. Toward the end of the stewing, add the toasted flour mixed with cold water (you can also add cream). The finished kebab is served with garnishes suitable for the respective diet.
Note: Option I is for boneless meat and Option II is for boneless meat. For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Poultry meat kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned chicken is washed and cut into portions, poured with a little water, salted and stewed over low heat until semi-soft. Add the cleaned and chopped peppers, peas, beans, okra (according to the duration of their heat treatment), butter, sliced ​​potatoes, peeled and sliced ​​or sliced ​​tomatoes, finely chopped parsley. The dish is baked in a moderate oven until the meat and vegetables are completely tender.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, for diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, it can be prepared with onions. When preparing the dish with a sterilized non-diet casserole for diets No. 5 and 7, blue tomatoes are removed and replaced with the same amount of another type of vegetable.
title: Poultry casserole

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned, washed and boiled, then deboned and cut into small pieces, and for diet No. 1 and 4 the skin is removed. Cleaned and washed carrots are cut into small cubes or grated on a large grater and stewed in a part of the oil and a little water. The mashed tomatoes are added to them. The mixture is diluted with the hot chicken stock, salted and brought to a boil. The cleaned and washed rice, the remaining oil and the chopped chicken meat are added to the resulting sauce. The dish is boiled over low heat or baked in a moderate oven until it remains in the fat, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and grated cheese and served.
Note: For diets 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 6, it can be prepared with 5 g of vegetable oil and without salt.

title: Poultry meat kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The well-cleaned and washed bird is deboned and cut into oblong, medium-sized pieces. Healthy leaves are separated from the cabbage, on which the thicker veins are cut. Put 1 piece of the poultry meat and 1 piece of the butter in each leaf, sprinkle with red pepper and a little salt and wrap in sarma. The sarmi are arranged in a suitable container, covered with several cabbage leaves, poured with hot water or broth and cooked over low heat, covering with a lid. 2-3 pieces are served. in a portion, covered with the sauce from the dish.
Note: For diet No. 8, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Poultry sarmi with cabbage leaves

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The well-cleaned and washed bird is deboned and cut into oblong, medium-sized pieces. Healthy leaves are separated from the cabbage, on which the thicker veins are cut. Put 1 piece of the poultry meat and 1 piece of the butter in each leaf, sprinkle with red pepper and a little salt and wrap in sarma. The sarmi are arranged in a suitable container, covered with several cabbage leaves, poured with hot water or broth and cooked over low heat, covering with a lid. 2-3 pieces are served. in a portion, covered with the sauce from the dish.
Note: For diet No. 8, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Poultry sarmi with cabbage leaves

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The well-cleaned and washed bird is salted (whole or cut into portions) and lightly stewed in butter and a little water, then the cleaned, washed and finely chopped carrots, celery (and onion) are added, and a little later the pureed tomatoes are added. The dish is covered with a lid and stewed over low heat, adding a little hot water. Finally, the toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water is added. When serving, the portioned pieces are poured with the pureed sauce from the dish, and a side dish suitable for the diets and the season is placed on the side.
Note:
For diets No. 8,10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 8, the dish is served with a sauce prepared with 5 g of butter. For diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, the dish can be prepared with onions.
title: Smothered bird

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The bird (chicken, lean turkey or hen) is cleaned and washed well, lightly salted, buttered on all sides and roasted in a moderate oven until browned, then covered with a little hot water and baked until the meat is completely tender, pouring the sauce from time to time. The finished bird is cut into portions, poured with the sauce and served with side dishes and salad suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 8 — with 5 g of butter. For diet No. 7, option II is used.
title: Oven-roasted bird

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned, washed and cut into two halves, which are lightly cracked, salted and baked on a greased and highly heated grill. When baking, the chicken is turned from time to time and smeared with melted butter, and after baking, it is cut into portions and immediately served with a variety of side dishes and salads suitable for the respective diets.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 7, option II is used.
title: Grilled chicken

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is salted and put on a skewer for roasting. It is placed in a heated grill and baked until a golden crust is formed, after which it is cut into quarters or portioned pieces with the help of scissors and served with side dishes and salad suitable for the season and the diet.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 7, option II is used.
title: Grilled chicken

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is placed in a container of hot water and boiled over low heat, after which it is deboned and the meat is ground in a meat grinder. The yolks are beaten until they turn white and the minced meat, part of the grated cheese, salt, milk, breadcrumbs and finally the egg whites beaten to stiff snow are added to them with gentle stirring. The mixture is poured into an individual cup greased with part of the butter, smoothed, sprinkled with the rest of the grated cheese and the butter and baked in a moderate oven. The finished pudding is served immediately after baking.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 4 and 5 — with 1 1/2 pcs. protein (37 g).
title: Chicken pudding

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is placed in a container of hot water and boiled over low heat, after which it is deboned and the meat is ground in a meat grinder. The yolks are beaten until they turn white and the minced meat, part of the grated cheese, salt, milk, breadcrumbs and finally the egg whites beaten to stiff snow are added to them with gentle stirring. The mixture is poured into an individual cup greased with part of the butter, smoothed, sprinkled with the rest of the grated cheese and the butter and baked in a moderate oven. The finished pudding is served immediately after baking.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 4 and 5 — with 1 1/2 pcs. protein (37 g).
title: Chicken pudding

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The crumbs are cleaned and washed well and placed in hot water to boil (blanch). The cleaned onion is coarsely chopped and lightly stewed in oil and a little water. Add the chopped potatoes, then the peeled and chopped tomatoes, the blanched livers and salt. The dish is poured with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. (The cream is added towards the end). After baking, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Baked chicken livers

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The well-cleaned and washed bird offal is cut and poured with hot water, salted and boiled over low heat. Cleaned and cut into cubes or shaped with a special spoon, carrots and celery are lightly stewed in a part of the butter and a little water and added to the trifles. The potatoes cut into cubes (or shaped with a special spoon) are added, and then the mashed tomatoes. The dish is cooked over low heat until done. Shortly before removing it from the fire, add the rest of the butter, and before serving it, add the finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Poultry trifle ragout

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in hot water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then taken out, placed in hot water. Salt it and let it boil on low heat together with the fat. The okra is cleaned from the stalks and left to stand for ten minutes in cold, slightly salted and vinegared water to remove its mucus, rubbed lightly with hands to remove its prickliness, rinsed with cold water and added to the semi-softened meat (the sterilized okra is added when the meat is completely soft). Then add the peeled and chopped or pureed tomatoes, the toasted flour, previously mixed with a little cold water, and finally the sliced ​​lemon (without the peel). The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. When the dish is prepared with sterilization. okra in a home. sauce, red tomatoes are not added and the yield is accordingly reduced to 280 g per serving. For diet No. 8, the dish can be prepared with 5 g of vegetable oil.
title: Beef with okra

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat until softened with some of the butter. Add the finely chopped parsley leaves and the finely chopped onions and carrots lightly stewed in the remaining oil and a little water. A mixture of whipped yogurt, eggs and toasted flour is prepared, which is added to the dish before removing it from the heat. Lemon juice can also be added to the mixture.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Veal with parsley

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons*, washed, cut into portions, placed in hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then taken out, placed in hot water, salted and allowed to boil over low heat together with the fat until semi-soft. Add the cleaned, washed and sliced ​​cabbage, lightly rubbed with salt. When the meat is soft, add the peeled and coarsely chopped tomatoes. The dish is baked in a moderate oven until the fat remains. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 9, 10, 11 and 15, it can be prepared with onions and sweet red pepper.
title: Beef with fresh cabbage

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed, cut into portions, put in hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then taken out, put in hot water, salted and left to boil over low heat together with the fat until semi-soft. The cleaned, washed and sliced ​​cabbage, lightly rubbed with salt, the cleaned and washed rice, the pureed (or peeled and chopped) tomatoes and a little hot water are successively added. The dish is mixed and baked in a moderate oven. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef with fresh cabbage and rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned, washed and cut into portions, placed in hot water to boil for 3-5 minutes, taken out and placed in hot water, salted and left to boil over low heat until softened together with part of the fat. Add the chopped onion (3-4 cm long) and slightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water, then the peeled and chopped tomatoes and the toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note: For diets #8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Lamb meat with fresh onions

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is boned, cleaned of skins and sinews and washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and allowed to boil over low heat with the fat. Add the cleaned, washed and chopped leeks (for diet No. 5, the chopped leeks are boiled for a few minutes in water, then drained and added to the meat). When the meat softens, add the pureed or peeled and chopped tomatoes, the savory, the black pepper and, finally, the toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat in a closed container or baked in a moderate oven. Serve with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets #8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets #11 and 15, it can be prepared with pork.
title: Teleshko meso with praz onion

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then taken out, placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat together with the quinces, previously cleaned of moss and seeds, washed and cut into slices or cubes, and part of the sugar. When the meat softens, add the pureed tomatoes, the remaining sugar and the toasted flour dissolved in cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven, adding the fresh butter at the end.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef with quinces

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Peppers are cleaned from the stalks, washed, dried, fried in hot fat and arranged on a plate. Pour the pureed tomatoes into the same fat and cook together with sugar and salt until thickened. Pour the prepared tomato sauce over the peppers, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve.
title: Fried peppers with tomato sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, which are poured with cold water and brought to a boil over high heat, and after removing the foam, they are salted and boiled over low heat until soft together with the cleaned and washed carrots and white roots. The tomatoes are boiled and mashed together with the boiled root vegetables. Toasted flour is added to the resulting puree. The mixture is diluted with some of the broth and cooked, whisking continuously with a wire, until it becomes a smooth sauce. Place the cooked meat in the sauce and add fresh butter and sugar. The dish is left to boil for a few minutes on low heat and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 8 it can be prepared with 5 g of butter.
title: Chicken with tomato sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, which are poured with cold water and brought to a boil over high heat, and after removing the foam, they are salted and boiled over low heat until soft together with the cleaned and washed carrots and white roots. The tomatoes are boiled and mashed together with the boiled root vegetables. Toasted flour is added to the resulting puree. The mixture is diluted with some of the broth and cooked, whisking continuously with a wire, until it becomes a smooth sauce. Place the cooked meat in the sauce and add fresh butter and sugar. The dish is left to boil for a few minutes on low heat and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 8 it can be prepared with 5 g of butter.
title: Chicken with tomato sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, poured with cold water and when it boils, skimmed and salted, then boiled over low heat until the meat is soft (the chicken can be boiled whole and then cut into portions). The toasted flour is diluted with the chicken broth and the resulting porridge is boiled over a low heat, constantly stirring with a wire. Finally, the fresh butter is added. When serving, the portions of meat are poured with the porridge and sprinkled with grated or crushed cheese.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and the cheese is desalted. For diets No. 7, 10, 11, 15, the flour can be lightly fried.
title: Chicken porridge with cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is cut into portions, poured with cold water and when it boils, skimmed and salted, then boiled over low heat until the meat is soft (the chicken can be boiled whole and then cut into portions). The toasted flour is diluted with the chicken broth and the resulting porridge is boiled over a low heat, constantly stirring with a wire. Finally, the fresh butter is added. When serving, the portions of meat are poured with the porridge and sprinkled with grated or crushed cheese.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and the cheese is desalted. For diets No. 7, 10, 11, 15, the flour can be lightly fried.
title: Chicken porridge with cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned chicken is washed and cut into portions, poured with a little water, salted and stewed over low heat until semi-soft. Add the cleaned and chopped peppers, peas, beans, okra (according to the duration of their heat treatment), butter, sliced ​​potatoes, peeled and sliced ​​or sliced ​​tomatoes, finely chopped parsley. The dish is baked in a moderate oven until the meat and vegetables are completely tender.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, for diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, it can be prepared with onions. When preparing the dish with a sterilized non-diet casserole for diets No. 5 and 7, blue tomatoes are removed and replaced with the same amount of another type of vegetable.
title: Poultry casserole

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned and washed chicken is salted and put on a skewer for roasting. It is placed in a heated grill and baked until a golden crust is formed, after which it is cut into quarters or portioned pieces with the help of scissors and served with side dishes and salad suitable for the season and the diet.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 7, option II is used.
title: Grilled chicken

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned, washed and deboned. The meat is ground together with bread previously soaked in milk or water and cleaned of the crust, mixed with eggs, salt, 1/2 of the butter and finely chopped parsley and left to stand in the cold for about 1 hour. Shape into meatballs (2 pieces per serving), place in a greased pan and bake in a moderate oven, adding a little hot water from time to time. The ready-made meatballs are served with a variety of toppings suitable for the respective diets.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 6 it can be prepared with 5 g of vegetable oil and 10 g of milk without salt.
title: Baked poultry meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The well-cleaned and washed bird offal is cut and poured with hot water, salted and boiled over low heat. Cleaned and cut into cubes or shaped with a special spoon, carrots and celery are lightly stewed in a part of the butter and a little water and added to the trifles. The potatoes cut into cubes (or shaped with a special spoon) are added, and then the mashed tomatoes. The dish is cooked over low heat until done. Shortly before removing it from the fire, add the rest of the butter, and before serving it, add the finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Poultry trifle ragout

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The crumbs are cleaned and washed well, placed in a pot of hot water and boiled until semi-soft. The sliced ​​onion is lightly stewed in the fat and the blanched livers and the pureed tomatoes are added to it. The dish is poured with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. Towards the end, add the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water and the salt. The finished dish is sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Chicken liver kebab

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: : Buns are filled with marmalade and baked until golden.
title: Muffins with marmalade

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: The cheese and egg are mixed and spread on the bread. Fry until slightly golden.
title: Princess with cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in hot water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then taken out, placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat together with the fat until softened. Then add the peeled and cut into medium-sized cubes, the peeled and chopped (or pureed) tomatoes and towards the end - the toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water. The dish is baked in the oven and sprinkled with finely chopped dill (parsley).
Note: For diets 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. The dish can be served with 30 g of yogurt per portion. For diets No. 6 and 3, the dish can be prepared with 5 g of vegetable oil.
title: Beef with zucchini

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned, cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portions and put in hot water to boil for a few minutes, then taken out, put in hot water, salted and with part of the fat left to boil over low heat. Add the cleaned and washed peas and the finely chopped onion lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water. When the meat softens, add the peeled and chopped tomatoes and the toasted flour mixed in a little cold water. The dish is baked in the oven and sprinkled with finely chopped dill or parsley. Sterilized peas are added to the dish when the meat is already tender.
Note: For diets No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef with peas

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Crumble the bread and cheese into a bowl. It is poured with hot water and oil.
title: Popara with cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in hot water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then taken out, placed in hot water. Salt it and let it boil on low heat together with the fat. The okra is cleaned from the stalks and left to stand for ten minutes in cold, slightly salted and vinegared water to remove its mucus, rubbed lightly with hands to remove its prickliness, rinsed with cold water and added to the semi-softened meat (the sterilized okra is added when the meat is completely soft). Then add the peeled and chopped or pureed tomatoes, the toasted flour, previously mixed with a little cold water, and finally the sliced ​​lemon (without the peel). The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note:
For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. When the dish is prepared with sterilization. okra in a home. sauce, red tomatoes are not added and the yield is accordingly reduced to 280 g per serving. For diet No. 8, the dish can be prepared with 5 g of vegetable oil.
title: Beef with okra

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned, cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed, cut into portions, put in hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then drained, put in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat together with the fat. When the meat softens, add the tomatoes (small, healthy, of the same size), sugar and toasted flour mixed with a little cold water. The dish is then cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 9, 10, 11 and 15, it can be prepared with onions.
title: Beef with red tomatoes

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Eggs are boiled and served with toast.
title: Boiled eggs with bread

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat until softened with some of the butter. Add the finely chopped parsley leaves and the finely chopped onions and carrots lightly stewed in the remaining oil and a little water. A mixture of whipped yogurt, eggs and toasted flour is prepared, which is added to the dish before removing it from the heat. Lemon juice can also be added to the mixture.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Veal with parsley

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned and washed, cut into portioned pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3 minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat together with fat and finely chopped carrots. The cleaned, washed and chopped lettuce and mashed (or peeled and chopped) tomatoes are added to the semi-cooked meat. The dish is cooked over low heat, finally adding flour dissolved in a little cold water, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill and served with yogurt.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Lamb meat with lettuce

author: Rihanna Angelova

The meat is cleaned and washed, cut into portioned pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3 minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat together with fat and finely chopped carrots. The cleaned, washed and chopped lettuce and mashed (or peeled and chopped) tomatoes are added to the semi-cooked meat. The dish is cooked over low heat, finally adding flour dissolved in a little cold water, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill and served with yogurt.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.

Then add the peas, green beans and diced potatoes, and a few minutes later add the peeled and finely chopped tomatoes. The dish is cooked over low heat and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.

Peas are cleaned and washed, boiled separately until soft and pureed. Add the mashed red tomatoes, the toasted flour dissolved in cold water and part of the resulting meat broth. The mixture is whisked over the fire with a wire until a smooth sauce is obtained. Add fresh butter and cooked meat to the sauce. The dish is left to boil on low heat for a few minutes, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill and served.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef with pea sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned and washed, placed in a container with a little hot water, salted and boiled over low heat together with the carrots and white roots until soft. Carrots and white roots are pureed and mixed with previously stewed and pureed apples. Add the fresh butter and let it boil for a few minutes on low heat. Cream is added to the finished sauce. The boiled meat is cut into portions, poured with the prepared sauce and served with suitable side dishes and salad.
Note: For diets No. 6, 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.

Add the cooked meat and let the dish simmer on low heat for a few minutes, then add the fresh butter and finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.

Peppers are washed and cleaned of seeds and stalks, washed again, cut, boiled and pureed. Add the mashed tomatoes, the toasted flour mixed with cold water and part of the resulting meat broth. The mixture is whisked over the fire until a smooth sauce is obtained, to which the meat and fresh oil are added. The dish is left to boil for a few minutes on low heat. Before serving, it can be sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef with pepper sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned of skins and tendons, washed and cut into cubes (4-6 pieces per portion), put in hot water and boil for 2-3 minutes, then take it out, put in hot water, add salt and let it boil on low heat together with part of the fat until semi-soft. Peeled and cubed or coarsely grated carrots and celery and finely chopped onion are lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water, mixed with red pepper and pureed tomatoes and added to the meat. The dish is stewed over low heat until the meat is completely tender, then the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water is added. The finished kebab is served with appropriate side dishes - steamed rice, mashed potatoes, etc.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Tas-kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Tender meat is selected, washed, cleaned and cut into pieces. Put it in hot water and boil it for 3 minutes, then take it out, salt it and stew it in the fat with a little hot water together with the finely chopped onion until soft. Yogurt and egg are beaten and mixed with toasted flour and lemon juice. The mixture is added to the meat. The dish is carefully mixed and baked in the oven.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, it can be prepared with onions.
title: Milk kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
A suitable meat is chosen (weisbrat, schol, apple, shoulder), cleaned of skins and tendons and washed, salted, spiked with some of the carrots and celery and stewed lightly in the fat and a little water. Add the onion and the remaining carrots and celery, chopped small, and then the peeled and chopped potatoes. A little hot water is added and the dish, tightly covered with a lid, is left to simmer over low heat. When the meat softens, add the mashed tomatoes and the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water. Simmering over low heat continues until the meat is completely tender. The meat is removed and cut into slices, which are divided into 2-3 pieces. in a portion and pour over the pureed sauce from the dish. A suitable side dish is served separately.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diets No. 8, 11, 15, the meat may not be boiled.
title: Stewed meat

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Elliptical portion pieces (1-2 pieces per portion) are formed from meat suitable for schnitzels (sholl, fillet, apple), which are cleaned and lightly pounded, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then taken out, drained, salted and lightly stewed in oil and a little water together with finely chopped onions, adding a little hot water from time to time. At the end of the stew, red pepper and cream (or well-beaten yogurt) are added. The dish is stirred slightly and after it boils, it is removed from the fire. It is served drizzled with the sauce and with a side dish of boiled rice, pasta or mashed potatoes.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 8, 11, 15, the meat may not be boiled beforehand.
title: Stewed veal schnitzel with cream

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The bird (chicken, lean turkey or hen) is cleaned and washed well, lightly salted, buttered on all sides and roasted in a moderate oven until browned, then covered with a little hot water and baked until the meat is completely tender, pouring the sauce from time to time. The finished bird is cut into portions, poured with the sauce and served with side dishes and salad suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 8 — with 5 g of butter. For diet No. 7, option II is used.
title: Oven-roasted bird

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned and washed, placed in a pot of hot water and boiled over low heat, after which it is deboned and the meat is ground. A béchamel sauce is prepared from the fresh milk, whipped with some of the butter, and the toasted flour. Add the mincemeat, egg yolks and beaten egg whites. The mixture is carefully stirred and poured into a buttered individual cup or other suitable container. Pieces of the remaining fresh butter are placed on top. The souffle is baked in a water bath. It is served immediately after its preparation.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 5 — with 1 1/2 pcs. protein (37 g).
