author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed, cut into portions, put in hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then taken out, put in hot water, salted and left to boil over low heat together with the fat until semi-soft. The cleaned, washed and sliced ​​cabbage, lightly rubbed with salt, the cleaned and washed rice, the pureed (or peeled and chopped) tomatoes and a little hot water are successively added. The dish is mixed and baked in a moderate oven. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef with fresh cabbage and rice

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal is deboned) is cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and allowed to boil over low heat until softened with some of the fat. Add the washed and chopped lettuce leaves and the onion lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water, and later the peeled and chopped tomatoes and the toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water. The dish is baked in a moderate oven and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill. It is served with yogurt.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Spring meat dish

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and, together with part of the fat, allowed to boil over low heat. To the softened meat, successively add the finely chopped and slightly stewed onion in the remaining fat and a little water, the cleaned and washed plums and the sugar (part of it can be caramelized), the pureed tomatoes, the cinnamon and, towards the end, the toasted flour, previously dissolved in a little cold water. The dish is boiled over low heat until done, covering tightly with a lid.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Veal with prunes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and together with some of the fat, left to boil over low heat. Cleaned, diced or shaped with a special spoon, carrots and celery are lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water and placed with the meat. The potatoes cut into cubes or shaped with a special spoon and the pureed tomatoes are then added. The dish is boiled until ready on low heat, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served.
Note: For diets #7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Stew from teleshko meso - Option 1

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and together with some of the fat, left to boil over low heat. Cleaned, diced or shaped with a special spoon, carrots and celery are lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water and placed with the meat. The potatoes cut into cubes or shaped with a special spoon and the pureed tomatoes are then added. The dish is boiled until ready on low heat, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served.
Note: For diets #7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Stew from teleshko meso - Option 1

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and allowed to boil over low heat with some of the fat. Cleaned and cut into cubes or shaped with a special spoon, carrots and celery are added to the softened meat, lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water. Then add the peas, green beans and diced potatoes, and a few minutes later add the peeled and finely chopped tomatoes. The dish is cooked over low heat and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Stew from teleshko meso - 2nd option

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and left to boil over low heat until completely softened together with carrots and white roots. The broth is strained. A sauce is prepared from the fresh or yogurt milk (or from both types of milk in a 1:1 ratio, eggs (yolks), toasted flour and part of the broth, which is boiled over low heat while constantly stirring and seasoned with lemon juice and fresh butter. When serving, the portioned pieces of meat are covered with the sauce.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Veal fricassee

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portioned pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat until soft. Peppers are washed and cleaned of seeds and stalks, washed again, cut, boiled and pureed. Add the mashed tomatoes, the toasted flour mixed with cold water and part of the resulting meat broth. The mixture is whisked over the fire until a smooth sauce is obtained, to which the meat and fresh oil are added. The dish is left to boil for a few minutes on low heat. Before serving, it can be sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef with pepper sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned and washed, placed in a container with a little hot water, salted and boiled over low heat together with the carrots and white roots until soft. Carrots and white roots are pureed and mixed with previously stewed and pureed apples. Add the fresh butter and let it boil for a few minutes on low heat. Cream is added to the finished sauce. The boiled meat is cut into portions, poured with the prepared sauce and served with suitable side dishes and salad.
Note: For diets No. 6, 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Domestic rabbit meat with sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Tender meat is chosen, which is washed and deboned, cut into pieces or cubes (7-8 pieces per portion), put in hot water and boil for 3 minutes, take out and mix with butter, pureed tomatoes, red pepper, salt and finely chopped parsley and chives. The mixture is allowed to stand in the cold for several hours and divided into portions, each of which is wrapped in oiled parchment paper as a square or rectangular packet. Arrange them in a greased pan in one row, sprinkle with a little water and bake in a moderate oven, adding a little water to the pan. Before serving them, the paper is cut.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 8, 9, 10, 11, 15, it can be prepared with onions and sweet red pepper.
title: Book kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (from the shoulder and the rib part) is washed, cut into pieces (5-6 pieces per portion), put in hot water and boiled for about 3 minutes, then put in hot water, salted and left to boil on low heat with part of the fat until soft. Add the onion (the white part) and the pureed tomatoes, lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water, and then the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water. The dish is stewed over low heat. Finally, finely chopped green onions, parsley, chives and savory are added. Served with a suitable side dish.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Lamb forest kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Elliptical portion pieces (1-2 pieces per portion) are formed from meat suitable for schnitzels (sholl, fillet, apple), which are cleaned and lightly pounded, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then taken out, drained, salted and lightly stewed in oil and a little water together with finely chopped onions, adding a little hot water from time to time. At the end of the stew, red pepper and cream (or well-beaten yogurt) are added. The dish is stirred slightly and after it boils, it is removed from the fire. It is served drizzled with the sauce and with a side dish of boiled rice, pasta or mashed potatoes.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 8, 11, 15, the meat may not be boiled beforehand.
title: Stewed veal schnitzel with cream

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Schnitzels are formed from suitable meat (sholl, apple), which are lightly pounded and salted. Cleaned, washed and coarsely grated carrots and celery are stewed in some fat and a little water together with finely chopped onions and mixed with pre-cooked rice and finely chopped parsley. A part of the prepared filling is placed on each schnitzel and wrapped in a roll, which is tied with a thread or stuck with a toothpick. The roulades are arranged in a shallow dish, poured with a little hot water and the remaining fat and stewed over low heat. Finally, add the mashed tomatoes and the toasted flour mixed with a little water. The finished roulades are released from the thread or the stick and are served flights with the pureed sauce and a suitable garnish.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef roulades

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned, washed and boiled, then deboned and cut into small pieces, and for diet No. 1 and 4 the skin is removed. Cleaned and washed carrots are cut into small cubes or grated on a large grater and stewed in a part of the oil and a little water. The mashed tomatoes are added to them. The mixture is diluted with the hot chicken stock, salted and brought to a boil. The cleaned and washed rice, the remaining oil and the chopped chicken meat are added to the resulting sauce. The dish is boiled over low heat or baked in a moderate oven until it remains in the fat, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and grated cheese and served.
Note: For diets 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 6, it can be prepared with 5 g of vegetable oil and without salt.
title: Chicken risotto

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The well-cleaned and washed bird is salted (whole or cut into portions) and lightly stewed in butter and a little water, then the cleaned, washed and finely chopped carrots, celery (and onion) are added, and a little later the pureed tomatoes are added. The dish is covered with a lid and stewed over low heat, adding a little hot water. Finally, the toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water is added. When serving, the portioned pieces are poured with the pureed sauce from the dish, and a side dish suitable for the diets and the season is placed on the side.
Note:
For diets No. 8,10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 8, the dish is served with a sauce prepared with 5 g of butter. For diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, the dish can be prepared with onions.
title: Smothered bird

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned, washed and cut into two halves, which are lightly cracked, salted and baked on a greased and highly heated grill. When baking, the chicken is turned from time to time and smeared with melted butter, and after baking, it is cut into portions and immediately served with a variety of side dishes and salads suitable for the respective diets.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 7, option II is used.
title: Grilled chicken

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned, washed and deboned. The meat is ground together with bread previously soaked in milk or water and cleaned of the crust, mixed with eggs, salt, 1/2 of the butter and finely chopped parsley and left to stand in the cold for about 1 hour. Shape into meatballs (2 pieces per serving), place in a greased pan and bake in a moderate oven, adding a little hot water from time to time. The ready-made meatballs are served with a variety of toppings suitable for the respective diets.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 6 it can be prepared with 5 g of vegetable oil and 10 g of milk without salt.
title: Baked poultry meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned and washed, placed in a pot of hot water and boiled over low heat until the meat is completely tender, after which it is deboned and the meat is ground in a meat grinder. A sauce is prepared from the milk, part of the butter and toasted flour, which is mixed with the ground chicken meat, salted and left to boil over low heat. The finished puree is seasoned with the remaining oil and served.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Chicken puree

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned and washed, placed in a pot of hot water and boiled over low heat until the meat is completely tender, after which it is deboned and the meat is ground in a meat grinder. A sauce is prepared from the milk, part of the butter and toasted flour, which is mixed with the ground chicken meat, salted and left to boil over low heat. The finished puree is seasoned with the remaining oil and served.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Chicken puree

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The chicken is cleaned and washed, placed in a pot of hot water and boiled over low heat, after which it is deboned and the meat is ground. A béchamel sauce is prepared from the fresh milk, whipped with some of the butter, and the toasted flour. Add the mincemeat, egg yolks and beaten egg whites. The mixture is carefully stirred and poured into a buttered individual cup or other suitable container. Pieces of the remaining fresh butter are placed on top. The souffle is baked in a water bath. It is served immediately after its preparation.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 5 — with 1 1/2 pcs. protein (37 g).
title: Chicken souffle

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The crumbs are cleaned and washed well and placed in hot water to boil (blanch). The cleaned onion is coarsely chopped and lightly stewed in oil and a little water. Add the chopped potatoes, then the peeled and chopped tomatoes, the blanched livers and salt. The dish is poured with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. (The cream is added towards the end). After baking, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Baked chicken livers

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: The minced meat is spread on the bread and baked.
title: Mincemeat Princess

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Dough is kneaded and small patties are made. Bake on a plate until red or in the oven.
title: Pearl

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned of skins and tendons and boned, (veal), cut into large pieces, placed in a pot of warm water and left to boil over low heat. Add the cleaned and washed carrots and white roots along with the salt. When tender, the meat is removed from the broth, cut into slices and served with a diet-friendly side dish and salad
Note: For diets No. 6, 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 6 and 7, it is prepared according to the II variant.
title: Boiled meat

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal) is deboned, cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed, cut into portions, put in hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then drained, put in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat together with the fat. When the meat softens, add the tomatoes (small, healthy, of the same size), sugar and toasted flour mixed with a little cold water. The dish is then cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 9, 10, 11 and 15, it can be prepared with onions.
title: Beef with red tomatoes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The beef is deboned, cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portioned pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and allowed to boil over low heat together with the fat. The cauliflower (cauliflower) is washed, cut into twigs and added to the softened meat, boiling it uncovered at the beginning so that it does not darken. Then add the mashed tomatoes and the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 6, 8, it can be prepared with 5 g of butter.
title: Beef with cauliflower

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal is deboned) is cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and allowed to boil over low heat until softened with some of the fat. Add the washed and chopped lettuce leaves and the onion lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water, and later the peeled and chopped tomatoes and the toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water. The dish is baked in a moderate oven and sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill. It is served with yogurt.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Spring meat dish

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned, washed and cut into portions, placed in hot water to boil for 3-5 minutes, taken out and placed in hot water, salted and left to boil over low heat until softened together with part of the fat. Add the chopped onion (3-4 cm long) and slightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water, then the peeled and chopped tomatoes and the toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley or dill.
Note: For diets #8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Lamb meat with fresh onions

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The veal is deboned, cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and allowed to boil over low heat together with some of the fat. Sauté the sliced ​​onion in the remaining fat and a little water, then the finely chopped carrots. The stewed vegetable is mixed with the red pepper and added together with the peeled and finely chopped tomatoes to the softened meat. Finally, the toasted flour dissolved in cold water is added. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in the oven. Serve sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.
title: Beef with onions

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and, together with part of the fat, allowed to boil over low heat. To the softened meat, successively add the finely chopped and slightly stewed onion in the remaining fat and a little water, the cleaned and washed plums and the sugar (part of it can be caramelized), the pureed tomatoes, the cinnamon and, towards the end, the toasted flour, previously dissolved in a little cold water. The dish is boiled over low heat until done, covering tightly with a lid.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Veal with prunes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then taken out, placed in hot water, salted and boiled over low heat together with the quinces, previously cleaned of moss and seeds, washed and cut into slices or cubes, and part of the sugar. When the meat softens, add the pureed tomatoes, the remaining sugar and the toasted flour dissolved in cold water. The dish is cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven, adding the fresh butter at the end.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef with quinces

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into portions, placed in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then placed in hot water, salted and left to boil over low heat until completely softened together with carrots and white roots. The broth is strained. A sauce is prepared from the fresh or yogurt milk (or from both types of milk in a 1:1 ratio, eggs (yolks), toasted flour and part of the broth, which is boiled over low heat while constantly stirring and seasoned with lemon juice and fresh butter. When serving, the portioned pieces of meat are covered with the sauce.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Veal fricassee

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The veal is deboned, cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portions, put in hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then taken out, put in hot water together with carrots and white roots, salted and left to boil over low heat until soft. From the cooked and pureed tomatoes, sugar, toasted flour diluted in a little cold water, and part of the resulting broth, a sauce is prepared, which is whipped over the fire until a smooth mixture is obtained. Add the cooked meat and let the dish simmer on low heat for a few minutes, then add the fresh butter and finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef with tomato sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned of skins and tendons, washed and cut into cubes (4-6 pieces per portion), put in hot water and boil for 2-3 minutes, then take it out, put in hot water, add salt and let it boil on low heat together with part of the fat until semi-soft. Peeled and cubed or coarsely grated carrots and celery and finely chopped onion are lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water, mixed with red pepper and pureed tomatoes and added to the meat. The dish is stewed over low heat until the meat is completely tender, then the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water is added. The finished kebab is served with appropriate side dishes - steamed rice, mashed potatoes, etc.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Tas-kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Tender meat is chosen, which is washed and deboned, cut into pieces or cubes (7-8 pieces per portion), put in hot water and boil for 3 minutes, take out and mix with butter, pureed tomatoes, red pepper, salt and finely chopped parsley and chives. The mixture is allowed to stand in the cold for several hours and divided into portions, each of which is wrapped in oiled parchment paper as a square or rectangular packet. Arrange them in a greased pan in one row, sprinkle with a little water and bake in a moderate oven, adding a little water to the pan. Before serving them, the paper is cut.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 8, 9, 10, 11, 15, it can be prepared with onions and sweet red pepper.
title: Book kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (from the shoulder and the rib part) is washed, cut into pieces (5-6 pieces per portion), put in hot water and boiled for about 3 minutes, then put in hot water, salted and left to boil on low heat with part of the fat until soft. Add the onion (the white part) and the pureed tomatoes, lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water, and then the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water. The dish is stewed over low heat. Finally, finely chopped green onions, parsley, chives and savory are added. Served with a suitable side dish.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Lamb forest kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Tender meat is selected, washed, cleaned and cut into pieces. Put it in hot water and boil it for 3 minutes, then take it out, salt it and stew it in the fat with a little hot water together with the finely chopped onion until soft. Yogurt and egg are beaten and mixed with toasted flour and lemon juice. The mixture is added to the meat. The dish is carefully mixed and baked in the oven.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, it can be prepared with onions.
title: Milk kebab

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
A suitable meat is chosen (weisbrat, schol, apple, shoulder), cleaned of skins and tendons and washed, salted, spiked with some of the carrots and celery and stewed lightly in the fat and a little water. Add the onion and the remaining carrots and celery, chopped small, and then the peeled and chopped potatoes. A little hot water is added and the dish, tightly covered with a lid, is left to simmer over low heat. When the meat softens, add the mashed tomatoes and the toasted flour mixed with a little cold water. Simmering over low heat continues until the meat is completely tender. The meat is removed and cut into slices, which are divided into 2-3 pieces. in a portion and pour over the pureed sauce from the dish. A suitable side dish is served separately.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diets No. 8, 11, 15, the meat may not be boiled.
title: Stewed meat

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Select suitable meat, clean and wash it, put it in hot water and boil it for 3-5 minutes, then remove it to a pan, add salt, pour the heated fat over it and bake it in a moderate oven until it turns slightly red, turning from time to time and pouring a little hot water on the side of the pan. Cleaned and finely chopped carrots and celery are added to the meat. The roasted meat is cut into slices (2-3 pieces per portion) and served with garnishes suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diets No. 8, 11 and 15, the meat may not be boiled. For diets 8, 9, 11 and 15, pork can be used.
title: Roasted meat

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal is deboned) is cleaned and washed, cut into portions, put in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then put in hot water, salted and left to boil on low heat until semi-soft together with the fat and finely chopped onions. The vegetables prepared for heat treatment — green beans, peas, okra and peppers — are added successively, and later the potatoes cut into circles, the tomatoes cut into slices and the parsley chopped into small pieces are added. The casserole is baked in a moderate oven until the meat and vegetables are tender. It is served immediately after its preparation.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 5, 7, when the dish is prepared with a sterilized non-diet casserole, the blue tomatoes are removed and replaced with the same amount of another type of vegetable.
title: Casserole with vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then removed and ground in a meat grinder with a large grate. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with the fat and part of the peeled and finely chopped or mashed tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil on a low heat. Then add the half-cooked rice and the finely chopped parsley and mix carefully (or arrange the minced meat and rice in successive layers). Arrange the remaining tomatoes, cut into slices, on top. Moussaka is poured with hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from fresh or yogurt milk, eggs and toasted flour, which is boiled over low heat for a few minutes, constantly whisking with a wire. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and baked until it turns red.
Note: For diets 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef and rice moussaka

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The minced meat is put in a suitable container together with the butter and the peeled and finely chopped tomatoes, salted, poured with hot water and left to boil over low heat. Add the cleaned, washed and finely chopped green beans, boiled in slightly salted water (the sterilized green beans are drained and finely chopped), and the finely chopped parsley. The mixture is gently stirred and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the whipped yogurt, egg and toasted flour, which is boiled for a few minutes on low heat, stirring constantly. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and roasted until red, let it rest for a few minutes and cut into portions.
Note: For diets 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef and green bean moussaka

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then drained and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with the pureed tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil over low heat. The washed and cleaned cauliflower is placed in boiling slightly salted water and boiled until soft, drained, cut into twigs and added to the minced meat together with butter and finely chopped parsley. The mixture is carefully mixed (or the minced meat and cauliflower are arranged in successive layers), poured with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the milk, beaten eggs and toasted flour, which is boiled over low heat for a few minutes. Pour the sauce over the moussaka and fry until golden brown, then let it rest for a few minutes, cut into portions and serve.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 6 and 8, it can be prepared with 1/2 of the prescribed amount of oil and salt.
title: Beef and cauliflower moussaka

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then drained and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with some of the butter and the peeled and finely chopped or mashed tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil over low heat. The cleaned cabbage is cut into strips, stewed in a little water and the remaining oil and added to the minced meat. Add the finely chopped parsley. The mixture is carefully mixed (or the minced meat and fresh cabbage are arranged in successive layers), poured with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the milk, egg and toasted flour, which is boiled over low heat for a few minutes. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and roasted until red, let it stand for a few minutes, cut into portions and serve.
Note: For diets 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef moussaka and fresh cabbage

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with some of the fat, salted and left to boil over low heat. Peeled carrots, celery, zucchini and potatoes are cut into small pieces (or coarsely grated) and stewed in the remaining fat and a little hot water, depending on their hardness. Add some of the pureed tomatoes. The stewed vegetables are added to the minced meat. Add the rest of the pureed tomatoes and the finely chopped parsley (fennel). The mixture is stirred carefully, adding a little water, and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the milk, egg and toasted flour, which is boiled over low heat until a smooth mixture is obtained. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and roasted until red, let it rest for a few minutes and cut into portions.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 6, the dish can be prepared with 1/2 of the intended amount of oil and salt.
title: Moussaka of beef and vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons and washed, cut into pieces, put in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. Cleaned and washed rice is poured with hot water (1:3), salted and boiled over low heat until soft together with the fat and part of the pureed tomatoes, then added to the minced meat. Add some of the finely chopped parsley (or dill) and the rest of the tomatoes. The mixture is stirred.
Zucchini are washed and scraped, cut off a little from both ends, hollowed out and filled with the prepared stuffing. They are then placed in a shallow dish or tray, covered with hot water and cooked over low heat until soft.
A mixture is prepared from the whipped yogurt, egg, toasted flour and sauce from the dish, which is boiled for 5-6 minutes on low heat, beating with a wire, and poured over the zucchini. After a few minutes, the dish is removed from the fire. When serving, sprinkle the zucchini with the remaining finely chopped parsley (or dill).
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 6 it can be prepared with 1/2 of the fat and salt.
title: Zucchini stuffed with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons and washed, cut into pieces, put in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. Tomatoes (medium-sized and healthy) are cut off from the stem and hollowed out inside. A part of the hollowed-out inside of the tomatoes is finely chopped and lightly stewed in some of the fat, then the rice is added, poured with the necessary amount of water, salted and boiled until soft. Add the minced meat and some of the finely chopped parsley to the cooked rice. Stir the mixture well and fill the hollowed-out tomatoes with it. Cover with the lids and arrange in a tray. The rest of their hollowed-out interior is placed around them. The dish is covered with the remaining fat and hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A mixture is prepared from eggs, toasted flour, milk and sauce from the dish, which is boiled for 2-3 minutes on low heat and added to the dish. After that, the dish is baked for a few more minutes and sprinkled with the remaining finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Stuffed red tomatoes with meat

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Firm and larger cabbages are chosen, which, after cutting the cob, are washed and boiled until softened in slightly salted and acidified water (with the hole facing down). Separate their leaves and cut out the thick veins (if the leaves are larger, they can be cut into two parts). The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The cleaned and washed rice is poured with hot water (1:2), salted and boiled until softened together with the fat and some of the mashed tomatoes, and then added to the meat. Add some of the finely chopped parsley and stir the mixture.
The mixture for the stuffing can be prepared by first stewing the peeled and finely chopped tomatoes and adding the rice and the appropriate amount of hot water to them, and after the rice has softened, add the meat, parsley and salt.
A part of the filling is placed at the base of each cabbage leaf, covered with the edges of the leaf and rolled into a roll. The sarms are arranged in a shallow dish or tray, covered with hot water and cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Prepare a sauce from the rest of the mashed tomatoes, the toasted flour and the sauce from the dish, which is boiled over low heat for 5-6 minutes while constantly whisking with a wire. Pour the finished sarmi with the sauce, let it boil or roast in the oven and serve sprinkled with the remaining finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. In diets No. 1 and 4, cabbage leaves are not consumed.
title: Cabbage leaf sarmi with beef

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.
title: Breaded vegetables (potatoes)

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.
title: Breaded vegetables (carrots)

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.
title: Breaded vegetables (carrots)

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
Peeled and washed zucchini are cut into slices, salted, rolled in flour and fried in hot fat. The fried slices are stuck together two by one with a filling made with part of the eggs and crushed cheese, breaded in flour, the rest of the eggs and breadcrumbs and lightly fried. They are served with yogurt or greens
salad and other vegetables according to the season.
title: Zucchini steak

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The cleaned and washed rice is poured with hot water, salted and boiled until softened together with the fat and part of the pureed tomatoes, after which it is added to the minced meat. Add the finely chopped parsley and the rest of the pureed tomatoes and mix well. Lettuce leaves (lettuce, collard greens, beets) are washed well and scalded with slightly salted water, after which the thick veins are cut. A portion of the prepared filling is placed in the middle of each leaf, covered with the edges of the leaf and rolled into a roll. The sarmi are arranged in a shallow dish or tray, poured with hot water (to cover), pressed with a plate and cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Prepare a mixture of the egg, yogurt, toasted flour and sauce from the dish, which is boiled for 5-6 minutes over low heat, constantly whisking with a wire, and poured over the sarmi. After a few minutes, the dish is removed from the heat and served.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 6 it can be prepared with 1/2 of the butter and salt.
title: Lettuce leaf sarmi with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The cleaned and washed rice is poured with hot water, salted and boiled until softened together with the fat and part of the pureed tomatoes, after which it is added to the minced meat. Add the finely chopped parsley and the rest of the pureed tomatoes and stir the mixture (the mixture for the stuffing can be prepared by first stewing the pureed tomatoes and adding the rice to them, pouring hot water and boiling until soft). The vine leaves are washed, scalded with hot (acidified) water and cleaned from the stalks. A part of the filling is wrapped in the middle of each sheet (with the front side out). The sarms are arranged in a shallow dish or tray, covered with hot water and cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Prepare a mixture of beaten eggs, milk, toasted flour and sauce from the dish, boil for a few minutes on low heat and pour over the sarmi before removing them from the heat.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. In diets No. 1, 4, vine leaves are not consumed. Sarmi can be served without construction - with the sauce from the dish and with 50 g of yogurt per portion.
title: Vine leaf sarmi with veal

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. Add the half-cooked rice, the finely chopped parsley and the egg. The mixture is salted and stirred. From it, elliptical meatballs are formed (3 pieces per portion), which are lightly rolled in flour. Carrots and white roots are boiled until soft, after which the decoction is strained. A sauce is prepared from the strained broth, toasted flour, butter and pureed tomatoes, into which the "naked sarmi" shaped like meatballs are placed and cooked over low heat until the sauce thickens.
Note: For diet #6, the dish can be prepared with 1/2 of the butter and salt.
title: Naked sarmi with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. Add the half-cooked rice, the finely chopped parsley and the egg. The mixture is salted and stirred. From it, elliptical meatballs are formed (3 pieces per portion), which are lightly rolled in flour. Carrots and white roots are boiled until soft, after which the decoction is strained. A sauce is prepared from the strained broth, toasted flour, butter and pureed tomatoes, into which the "naked sarmi" shaped like meatballs are placed and cooked over low heat until the sauce thickens.
Note: For diet #6, the dish can be prepared with 1/2 of the butter and salt.
title: Naked sarmi with beef

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The tomatoes are pureed and cooked until thickened together with the fat. The eggs are carefully broken, placed in boiling salted water and boiled until the white is covered. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a plate, pour over tomato sauce and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
title: Poached eggs with tomato sauce

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Roasted, peeled and seeded peppers are cut into strips and lightly sautéed in fat. The pureed tomatoes are added and also stewed. When the liquid evaporates, add the crumbled cheese and eggs. The mixture is left on low heat until the eggs are fried, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served.
title: Peppers with cheese and eggs (mishmash)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons and cut into pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3 minutes, then ground 1-2 times in a meat grinder together with the bread soaked in milk and mixed with the eggs, finely chopped parsley, salt and 1/2 of the fat. The mixture is left for 1/2-1 hour in the cold. Make meatballs (2 pieces per portion) from it, which are placed in a pan greased with the remaining fat and baked in a moderate oven, adding less hot water. They are served warm with side dishes and salads suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diets No. 6, 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Baked beef meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of skins and sinews, washed, cut into pieces and ground in a meat grinder together with water-soaked and squeezed bread. Add the eggs and salt. The mixture is kneaded well and left for about 1 hour in the cold. Form meatballs (2 pieces per serving), place them in a greased pan and bake in a moderate oven. A decoction is made from the cleaned, washed and coarsely chopped carrots and white roots, which is strained and heated again until boiling. The toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water is added, and while continuously whisking with a wire, a smooth sauce is prepared, in which the butter and semi-baked meatballs are added. The dish is left to boil for a few minutes on low heat, seasoned with lemon juice and served.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef meatballs with white sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into pieces and ground. Add the water-soaked and squeezed bread. The meat is ground again, mixed with finely chopped parsley, egg yolk and salt, left for about 1/2 hour in the cold and spread on a wet cloth in a rectangular layer, about 2 cm thick. In the middle of the layer, along its length, are placed the cooked and cut into strips carrots and celery. With the help of the cloth, the meat with the stuffing is rolled into a roll, which is pressed along the length and at the ends, placed in a suitable container, smeared with the beaten egg white, poured with the heated fat, pierced in several places with a fork and baked in a moderate oven, pouring a little hot water on the side from time to time. The baked roll is cut into slices and served with diet-friendly toppings. Cooked carrots and roots can be diced and added to minced meat instead of being added as a stuffing. The roll can be topped with a suitable sauce (50 g per portion) before serving.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef roll

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned of skins and sinews, cut into pieces, salted and ground in a meat grinder with a diameter of 3-4 mm grate holes, then kneaded, spread in a tray or other shallow container in a layer 10-12 cm thick and left to age in the refrigerator for several hours (up to a day). After that, it is kneaded well again, adding the fat and water and forming into kebabs (2 pieces per portion weighing 50 g). The kebabs are arranged on a previously greased and heated grill without touching each other, and are grilled evenly on all sides, carefully turning with a rolling pin. Baked kebabs should be juicy, but not raw. Immediately after baking, they are served with a variety of side dishes and salads according to the requirements of the respective diets.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Grilled beef kebabs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Cutlets are formed from suitable meat, which are lightly pounded, placed in warm water and boiled for 3 minutes, then drained and salted, arranged in a greased pan, sprinkled with the heated fat and baked in a moderate oven, turning from time to time and adding a little hot water to the pan. They are served with side dishes and salads suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diets No. 6, 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diets No. 8, 11 and 15, it is not necessary to boil the meat.
title: Oven-baked beef cutlets

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Cutlets are formed from suitable meat, which are lightly pounded, placed in warm water and boiled for 3 minutes, then drained and salted, arranged in a greased pan, sprinkled with the heated fat and baked in a moderate oven, turning from time to time and adding a little hot water to the pan. They are served with side dishes and salads suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diets No. 6, 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diets No. 8, 11 and 15, it is not necessary to boil the meat.
title: Oven-baked beef cutlets

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (the veal is deboned) is cleaned and washed, cut into portions, put in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then put in hot water, salted and left to boil on low heat until semi-soft along with the fat. Add the deseeded and sliced ​​peppers, then the cleaned and washed rice. When the rice swells, add the peeled and chopped tomatoes. The casserole is baked in a moderate oven until it remains almost in the fat, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Slavic casserole

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned of bones, skins and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, after which it is taken out and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with the butter and part of the peeled and finely chopped (or pureed) tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil over low heat. Add the sliced ​​or diced potatoes and the finely chopped parsley. Carefully mix (or arrange the minced meat and potatoes in successive layers). The dish is covered with the remaining sliced ​​tomatoes, poured with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A topping is prepared from the whipped milk, eggs and toasted flour, which is boiled for a few minutes on low heat and poured over the dish. The moussaka is grilled and left to rest for a few minutes, after which it is cut into portions.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef and potato moussaka

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned. cleaned of skins and sinews, washed and cut into pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with some of the fat and the pureed tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil over low heat. The leek is cleaned and washed, cut into small pieces, lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water (for diet No. 5, the chopped leek is boiled for a few minutes, then drained) and added to the minced meat. Add the remaining tomatoes and the finely chopped parsley. The mixture is stirred gently, adding a little hot water, and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the milk, egg and toasted flour, which is boiled with continuous stirring over low heat until a smooth mixture is obtained. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and roasted until red, let it stand for a few minutes, cut into portions and serve.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 11, 15 it can be prepared with pork.
title: Moussaka from teleshko meso and praz luk

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with some of the fat, salted and left to boil over low heat. Peeled carrots, celery, zucchini and potatoes are cut into small pieces (or coarsely grated) and stewed in the remaining fat and a little hot water, depending on their hardness. Add some of the pureed tomatoes. The stewed vegetables are added to the minced meat. Add the rest of the pureed tomatoes and the finely chopped parsley (fennel). The mixture is stirred carefully, adding a little water, and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the milk, egg and toasted flour, which is boiled over low heat until a smooth mixture is obtained. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and roasted until red, let it rest for a few minutes and cut into portions.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 6, the dish can be prepared with 1/2 of the intended amount of oil and salt.
title: Moussaka of beef and vegetables

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.

Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 6 it can be prepared with 1/2 of the fat and salt.
title: Zucchini stuffed with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and allowed to boil, after which it is removed and ground. Finely chopped onions, carrots and celery are lightly stewed in some of the fat and a little water, and then the minced meat, mashed red tomatoes and rice are added. The mixture is salted, poured with hot water and left on low heat until the rice softens. Add some of the finely chopped parsley and stir the mixture.
Choose medium-sized blue tomatoes (eggplants). Their stems are cut off to the base and along their length in several places their bark is peeled and shallow cuts are made, which are sprinkled with salt. After ten minutes, the blue tomatoes are gently squeezed to remove their bitter juice, and a lid is cut lengthwise. They are carved into a boat shape and lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water. Arrange them in a tray with the cut side up and fill them with the prepared stuffing. Cover with the cap and slices or rings of tomato, cover with hot water and bake in a moderate oven. A mixture of milk, egg and toasted flour is prepared, which is boiled for 2-3 minutes on low heat. The dish is poured with the mixture and baked for a few more minutes. Serve sprinkled with the remaining finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Stuffed blue tomatoes (aubergines) with beef

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.
