After a few minutes, the dish is removed from the heat and served.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diet No. 6 it can be prepared with 1/2 of the butter and salt.
title: Lettuce leaf sarmi with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons. Wash and cut into pieces. Place in warm water and boil until soft. Take it out and grind it 1 or 2 times in a meat grinder together with the bread soaked in milk. Add the egg, finely chopped parsley and salt. The mixture is kneaded well and meatballs are formed from it (2 pieces per portion), which are steamed. They are served with garnishes suitable for the respective diets.
title: Steamed beef meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into pieces and ground in a meat grinder with a fine grate. Add the bread soaked in milk and squeezed, the egg, finely chopped parsley and salt to the minced meat. The mixture is kneaded well and left to stand in the cold for 1/2 - 1 hour. Meatballs are formed from it (2 pcs. per portion). A decoction is made from the cleaned, washed and coarsely chopped carrots and roots, in which, after it boils, the meatballs are placed and cooked over low heat until soft. Serve immediately after removing from the broth with diet-friendly garnishes.
Note: For diets No. 6, 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Boiled beef meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into pieces, put in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then grind in a meat grinder together with the curd. Add the egg, milk, finely chopped parsley, part of the butter and salt to the minced meat. The mixture is kneaded and left to cool for about 1 hour. From it, meatballs are formed, which are lightly rolled in flour, placed in the pan greased with the remaining oil and baked in a moderate oven, adding a little hot water. They are served with appropriate garnishes and salads.
Note: For diets No. 6, 7, 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef meatballs and cottage cheese

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons and cut into pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3 minutes, then ground 1-2 times in a meat grinder together with the bread soaked in milk and mixed with the eggs, finely chopped parsley, salt and 1/2 of the fat. The mixture is left for 1/2-1 hour in the cold. Make meatballs (2 pieces per portion) from it, which are placed in a pan greased with the remaining fat and baked in a moderate oven, adding less hot water. They are served warm with side dishes and salads suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diets No. 6, 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Baked beef meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of skins and sinews, washed, cut into pieces and ground in a meat grinder together with water-soaked and squeezed bread. Add the eggs and salt. The mixture is kneaded well and left for about 1 hour in the cold. Form meatballs (2 pieces per serving), place them in a greased pan and bake in a moderate oven. A decoction is made from the cleaned, washed and coarsely chopped carrots and white roots, which is strained and heated again until boiling. The toasted flour dissolved in a little cold water is added, and while continuously whisking with a wire, a smooth sauce is prepared, in which the butter and semi-baked meatballs are added. The dish is left to boil for a few minutes on low heat, seasoned with lemon juice and served.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef meatballs with white sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Select suitable meat, clean and wash it, put it in hot water and boil it for 3-5 minutes, then remove it to a pan, add salt, pour the heated fat over it and bake it in a moderate oven until it turns slightly red, turning from time to time and pouring a little hot water on the side of the pan. Cleaned and finely chopped carrots and celery are added to the meat. The roasted meat is cut into slices (2-3 pieces per portion) and served with garnishes suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diets No. 8, 11 and 15, the meat may not be boiled. For diets 8, 9, 11 and 15, pork can be used.
title: Roasted meat

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The corresponding semi-finished products are formed from appropriate beef and lamb meat, pounded lightly, salted and baked on both sides on a grill pre-greased with fat and moderately heated. Make sure that the meat is juicy, but not raw. It is served immediately after baking with appropriate garnishes and salads according to the season and diet.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. One or several types of roasted meat are selected for one portion according to the requirements of individual diets.
title: Veal and lamb — grilled

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The corresponding semi-finished products are formed from appropriate beef and lamb meat, pounded lightly, salted and baked on both sides on a grill pre-greased with fat and moderately heated. Make sure that the meat is juicy, but not raw. It is served immediately after baking with appropriate garnishes and salads according to the season and diet.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. One or several types of roasted meat are selected for one portion according to the requirements of individual diets.
title: Veal and lamb — grilled

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal is deboned) is cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portioned pieces, placed in a pot of hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then removed to another pot, poured with a little hot water, salted and stewed in a moderate oven, adding the fat and slightly stewed onions. When the meat is tender, the dish is poured with a mixture of beaten eggs, yogurt and toasted flour and fried until it remains in the fat.
Note: For diets 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, it is prepared with slightly stewed onions. For diet #5, instead of a whole egg, prepare with 1 1/2 egg whites per serving. For diet No. 7, instead of a whole egg, it is prepared with 2 yolks.
title: Milk casserole

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned. cleaned of skins and sinews, washed and cut into pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with some of the fat and the pureed tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil over low heat. The leek is cleaned and washed, cut into small pieces, lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water (for diet No. 5, the chopped leek is boiled for a few minutes, then drained) and added to the minced meat. Add the remaining tomatoes and the finely chopped parsley. The mixture is stirred gently, adding a little hot water, and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the milk, egg and toasted flour, which is boiled with continuous stirring over low heat until a smooth mixture is obtained. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and roasted until red, let it stand for a few minutes, cut into portions and serve.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 11, 15 it can be prepared with pork.
title: Moussaka from teleshko meso and praz luk

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and allowed to boil, after which it is removed and ground. Finely chopped onions, carrots and celery are lightly stewed in some of the fat and a little water, and then the minced meat, mashed red tomatoes and rice are added. The mixture is salted, poured with hot water and left on low heat until the rice softens. Add some of the finely chopped parsley and stir the mixture.
Choose medium-sized blue tomatoes (eggplants). Their stems are cut off to the base and along their length in several places their bark is peeled and shallow cuts are made, which are sprinkled with salt. After ten minutes, the blue tomatoes are gently squeezed to remove their bitter juice, and a lid is cut lengthwise. They are carved into a boat shape and lightly stewed in the remaining fat and a little water. Arrange them in a tray with the cut side up and fill them with the prepared stuffing. Cover with the cap and slices or rings of tomato, cover with hot water and bake in a moderate oven. A mixture of milk, egg and toasted flour is prepared, which is boiled for 2-3 minutes on low heat. The dish is poured with the mixture and baked for a few more minutes. Serve sprinkled with the remaining finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diet No. 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Stuffed blue tomatoes (aubergines) with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Firm and larger cabbages are chosen, which, after cutting the cob, are washed and boiled until softened in slightly salted and acidified water (with the hole facing down). Separate their leaves and cut out the thick veins (if the leaves are larger, they can be cut into two parts). The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The cleaned and washed rice is poured with hot water (1:2), salted and boiled until softened together with the fat and some of the mashed tomatoes, and then added to the meat. Add some of the finely chopped parsley and stir the mixture.
The mixture for the stuffing can be prepared by first stewing the peeled and finely chopped tomatoes and adding the rice and the appropriate amount of hot water to them, and after the rice has softened, add the meat, parsley and salt.
A part of the filling is placed at the base of each cabbage leaf, covered with the edges of the leaf and rolled into a roll. The sarms are arranged in a shallow dish or tray, covered with hot water and cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Prepare a sauce from the rest of the mashed tomatoes, the toasted flour and the sauce from the dish, which is boiled over low heat for 5-6 minutes while constantly whisking with a wire. Pour the finished sarmi with the sauce, let it boil or roast in the oven and serve sprinkled with the remaining finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. In diets No. 1 and 4, cabbage leaves are not consumed.
title: Cabbage leaf sarmi with beef

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.
title: Breaded vegetables (peppers)

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.
title: Breaded vegetables (peppers)

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
Peeled and washed zucchini are cut into slices, salted, rolled in flour and fried in hot fat. The fried slices are stuck together two by one with a filling made with part of the eggs and crushed cheese, breaded in flour, the rest of the eggs and breadcrumbs and lightly fried. They are served with yogurt or greens
salad and other vegetables according to the season.
title: Zucchini steak

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The tomatoes are pureed and cooked until thickened together with the fat. The eggs are carefully broken, placed in boiling salted water and boiled until the white is covered. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a plate, pour over tomato sauce and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
title: Poached eggs with tomato sauce

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The tomatoes are pureed and cooked until thickened together with the fat. The eggs are carefully broken, placed in boiling salted water and boiled until the white is covered. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a plate, pour over tomato sauce and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
title: Poached eggs with tomato sauce

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Roasted, peeled and seeded peppers are cut into strips and lightly sautéed in fat. The pureed tomatoes are added and also stewed. When the liquid evaporates, add the crumbled cheese and eggs. The mixture is left on low heat until the eggs are fried, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served.
title: Peppers with cheese and eggs (mishmash)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into pieces and placed in hot water, boiled for 3 minutes, taken out and ground. The minced meat is mixed with fresh milk, eggs, 1/2 of the fat and salt. Elliptical schnitzels are formed, which are lightly rolled in flour, placed in a pan greased with the remaining fat and baked in a moderate oven, adding a little hot water from time to time. Serve warm with a slice of lemon and a suitable side dish and salad.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Ground beef schnitzel

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then ground. Add the pre-soaked bread in milk. The meat is ground again and mixed with the finely chopped onion and parsley, the egg, salt and 1/5 of the fat. Leave to cool for about 1 hour and form into meatballs (2 pieces per portion). The meatballs are rolled in flour, flattened slightly and fried in the remaining hot fat. They are served with a variety of side dishes and salads according to the season and dietary requirements.
Note: Meatballs of 63 g are formed in raw form (2 pieces per portion).
title: Fried beef meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then ground. Add the pre-soaked bread in milk. The meat is ground again and mixed with the finely chopped onion and parsley, the egg, salt and 1/5 of the fat. Leave to cool for about 1 hour and form into meatballs (2 pieces per portion). The meatballs are rolled in flour, flattened slightly and fried in the remaining hot fat. They are served with a variety of side dishes and salads according to the season and dietary requirements.
Note: Meatballs of 63 g are formed in raw form (2 pieces per portion).
title: Fried beef meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed, cut into pieces and ground. Add the water-soaked and squeezed bread. The meat is ground again, mixed with finely chopped parsley, egg yolk and salt, left for about 1/2 hour in the cold and spread on a wet cloth in a rectangular layer, about 2 cm thick. In the middle of the layer, along its length, are placed the cooked and cut into strips carrots and celery. With the help of the cloth, the meat with the stuffing is rolled into a roll, which is pressed along the length and at the ends, placed in a suitable container, smeared with the beaten egg white, poured with the heated fat, pierced in several places with a fork and baked in a moderate oven, pouring a little hot water on the side from time to time. The baked roll is cut into slices and served with diet-friendly toppings. Cooked carrots and roots can be diced and added to minced meat instead of being added as a stuffing. The roll can be topped with a suitable sauce (50 g per portion) before serving.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef roll

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Schnitzels are formed from suitable meat (sholl, apple), which are lightly pounded and salted. Cleaned, washed and coarsely grated carrots and celery are stewed in some fat and a little water together with finely chopped onions and mixed with pre-cooked rice and finely chopped parsley. A part of the prepared filling is placed on each schnitzel and wrapped in a roll, which is tied with a thread or stuck with a toothpick. The roulades are arranged in a shallow dish, poured with a little hot water and the remaining fat and stewed over low heat. Finally, add the mashed tomatoes and the toasted flour mixed with a little water. The finished roulades are released from the thread or the stick and are served flights with the pureed sauce and a suitable garnish.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef roulades

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Semi-finished products are formed from suitable lean pork. They are pounded lightly, salted and baked on both sides on a moderately heated grill pre-greased with fat, taking care that the meat is juicy without remaining raw. The roasted meat is served immediately with side dishes and salads suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diet No. 8, the dish is prepared without salt. One or several types of roasted meat are selected for one portion according to the requirements of individual diets.
title: Pork — grilled

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Semi-finished products are formed from suitable lean pork. They are pounded lightly, salted and baked on both sides on a moderately heated grill pre-greased with fat, taking care that the meat is juicy without remaining raw. The roasted meat is served immediately with side dishes and salads suitable for the diet and the season.
Note: For diet No. 8, the dish is prepared without salt. One or several types of roasted meat are selected for one portion according to the requirements of individual diets.
title: Pork — grilled

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal is deboned) is cleaned and washed, cut into portions, put in warm water and boiled for a few minutes, then put in hot water, salted and left to boil on low heat until semi-soft together with the fat and finely chopped onions. The vegetables prepared for heat treatment — green beans, peas, okra and peppers — are added successively, and later the potatoes cut into circles, the tomatoes cut into slices and the parsley chopped into small pieces are added. The casserole is baked in a moderate oven until the meat and vegetables are tender. It is served immediately after its preparation.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diet No. 5, 7, when the dish is prepared with a sterilized non-diet casserole, the blue tomatoes are removed and replaced with the same amount of another type of vegetable.
title: Casserole with vegetables

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (the veal is deboned) is cleaned and washed, cut into portions, put in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, then put in hot water, salted and left to boil on low heat until semi-soft along with the fat. Add the deseeded and sliced ​​peppers, then the cleaned and washed rice. When the rice swells, add the peeled and chopped tomatoes. The casserole is baked in a moderate oven until it remains almost in the fat, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served immediately.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Slavic casserole

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat (veal is deboned) is cleaned of skins and tendons, washed, cut into portioned pieces, placed in a pot of hot water and boiled for a few minutes, then removed to another pot, poured with a little hot water, salted and stewed in a moderate oven, adding the fat and slightly stewed onions. When the meat is tender, the dish is poured with a mixture of beaten eggs, yogurt and toasted flour and fried until it remains in the fat.
Note: For diets 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt. For diets No. 9, 10, 11, 15, it is prepared with slightly stewed onions. For diet #5, instead of a whole egg, prepare with 1 1/2 egg whites per serving. For diet No. 7, instead of a whole egg, it is prepared with 2 yolks.
title: Milk casserole

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned of bones, skins and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in warm water and boiled for 3-5 minutes, after which it is taken out and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with the butter and part of the peeled and finely chopped (or pureed) tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil over low heat. Add the sliced ​​or diced potatoes and the finely chopped parsley. Carefully mix (or arrange the minced meat and potatoes in successive layers). The dish is covered with the remaining sliced ​​tomatoes, poured with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A topping is prepared from the whipped milk, eggs and toasted flour, which is boiled for a few minutes on low heat and poured over the dish. The moussaka is grilled and left to rest for a few minutes, after which it is cut into portions.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef and potato moussaka

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then removed and ground in a meat grinder with a large grate. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with the fat and part of the peeled and finely chopped or mashed tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil on a low heat. Then add the half-cooked rice and the finely chopped parsley and mix carefully (or arrange the minced meat and rice in successive layers). Arrange the remaining tomatoes, cut into slices, on top. Moussaka is poured with hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from fresh or yogurt milk, eggs and toasted flour, which is boiled over low heat for a few minutes, constantly whisking with a wire. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and baked until it turns red.
Note: For diets 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef and rice moussaka

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The minced meat is put in a suitable container together with the butter and the peeled and finely chopped tomatoes, salted, poured with hot water and left to boil over low heat. Add the cleaned, washed and finely chopped green beans, boiled in slightly salted water (the sterilized green beans are drained and finely chopped), and the finely chopped parsley. The mixture is gently stirred and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the whipped yogurt, egg and toasted flour, which is boiled for a few minutes on low heat, stirring constantly. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and roasted until red, let it rest for a few minutes and cut into portions.
Note: For diets 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef and green bean moussaka

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then drained and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with the pureed tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil over low heat. The washed and cleaned cauliflower is placed in boiling slightly salted water and boiled until soft, drained, cut into twigs and added to the minced meat together with butter and finely chopped parsley. The mixture is carefully mixed (or the minced meat and cauliflower are arranged in successive layers), poured with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the milk, beaten eggs and toasted flour, which is boiled over low heat for a few minutes. Pour the sauce over the moussaka and fry until golden brown, then let it rest for a few minutes, cut into portions and serve.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt, and for diets No. 6 and 8, it can be prepared with 1/2 of the prescribed amount of oil and salt.
title: Beef and cauliflower moussaka

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then drained and ground. The minced meat is placed in a suitable container together with some of the butter and the peeled and finely chopped or mashed tomatoes, salted, poured with a little hot water and left to boil over low heat. The cleaned cabbage is cut into strips, stewed in a little water and the remaining oil and added to the minced meat. Add the finely chopped parsley. The mixture is carefully mixed (or the minced meat and fresh cabbage are arranged in successive layers), poured with a little hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A sauce is prepared from the milk, egg and toasted flour, which is boiled over low heat for a few minutes. The moussaka is poured with the sauce and roasted until red, let it stand for a few minutes, cut into portions and serve.
Note: For diets 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef moussaka and fresh cabbage

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned, cleaned of membranes and tendons and washed, cut into pieces, put in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. Tomatoes (medium-sized and healthy) are cut off from the stem and hollowed out inside. A part of the hollowed-out inside of the tomatoes is finely chopped and lightly stewed in some of the fat, then the rice is added, poured with the necessary amount of water, salted and boiled until soft. Add the minced meat and some of the finely chopped parsley to the cooked rice. Stir the mixture well and fill the hollowed-out tomatoes with it. Cover with the lids and arrange in a tray. The rest of their hollowed-out interior is placed around them. The dish is covered with the remaining fat and hot water and baked in a moderate oven. A mixture is prepared from eggs, toasted flour, milk and sauce from the dish, which is boiled for 2-3 minutes on low heat and added to the dish. After that, the dish is baked for a few more minutes and sprinkled with the remaining finely chopped parsley.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Stuffed red tomatoes with meat

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.
title: Breaded vegetables (potatoes)

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.
title: Breaded vegetables (leek and onion)

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Vegetables (cauliflower, potatoes, carrots, leeks and zucchini) are cut (in slices, pieces or twigs), boiled in slightly salted water, dipped in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. The peppers are roasted and peeled, then breaded in the manner described above. They are served with yogurt.
title: Breaded Vegetables (Zucchini)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, washed and cut into pieces, placed in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then taken out and ground. The cleaned and washed rice is poured with hot water, salted and boiled until softened together with the fat and part of the pureed tomatoes, after which it is added to the minced meat. Add the finely chopped parsley and the rest of the pureed tomatoes and stir the mixture (the mixture for the stuffing can be prepared by first stewing the pureed tomatoes and adding the rice to them, pouring hot water and boiling until soft). The vine leaves are washed, scalded with hot (acidified) water and cleaned from the stalks. A part of the filling is wrapped in the middle of each sheet (with the front side out). The sarms are arranged in a shallow dish or tray, covered with hot water and cooked over low heat or baked in a moderate oven. Prepare a mixture of beaten eggs, milk, toasted flour and sauce from the dish, boil for a few minutes on low heat and pour over the sarmi before removing them from the heat.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt. In diets No. 1, 4, vine leaves are not consumed. Sarmi can be served without construction - with the sauce from the dish and with 50 g of yogurt per portion.
title: Vine leaf sarmi with veal

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons. Wash and cut into pieces. Place in warm water and boil until soft. Take it out and grind it 1 or 2 times in a meat grinder together with the bread soaked in milk. Add the egg, finely chopped parsley and salt. The mixture is kneaded well and meatballs are formed from it (2 pieces per portion), which are steamed. They are served with garnishes suitable for the respective diets.
title: Steamed beef meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into pieces and ground in a meat grinder with a fine grate. Add the bread soaked in milk and squeezed, the egg, finely chopped parsley and salt to the minced meat. The mixture is kneaded well and left to stand in the cold for 1/2 - 1 hour. Meatballs are formed from it (2 pcs. per portion). A decoction is made from the cleaned, washed and coarsely chopped carrots and roots, in which, after it boils, the meatballs are placed and cooked over low heat until soft. Serve immediately after removing from the broth with diet-friendly garnishes.
Note: For diets No. 6, 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Boiled beef meatballs

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: The tomatoes are pureed and cooked until thickened together with the fat. The eggs are carefully broken, placed in boiling salted water and boiled until the white is covered. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a plate, pour over tomato sauce and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
title: Poached eggs with tomato sauce

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into pieces, put in hot water and boiled for 3 minutes, then grind in a meat grinder together with the curd. Add the egg, milk, finely chopped parsley, part of the butter and salt to the minced meat. The mixture is kneaded and left to cool for about 1 hour. From it, meatballs are formed, which are lightly rolled in flour, placed in the pan greased with the remaining oil and baked in a moderate oven, adding a little hot water. They are served with appropriate garnishes and salads.
Note: For diets No. 6, 7, 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Beef meatballs and cottage cheese

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Roasted, peeled and seeded peppers are cut into strips and lightly sautéed in fat. The pureed tomatoes are added and also stewed. When the liquid evaporates, add the crumbled cheese and eggs. The mixture is left on low heat until the eggs are fried, sprinkled with finely chopped parsley and served.
title: Peppers with cheese and eggs (mishmash)

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into pieces and placed in hot water, boiled for 3 minutes, taken out and ground. The minced meat is mixed with fresh milk, eggs, 1/2 of the fat and salt. Elliptical schnitzels are formed, which are lightly rolled in flour, placed in a pan greased with the remaining fat and baked in a moderate oven, adding a little hot water from time to time. Serve warm with a slice of lemon and a suitable side dish and salad.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Ground beef schnitzel

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned of skins and tendons, cut into pieces and salted, then ground in a meat grinder with a grate diameter of 3-4 mm, kneaded and placed in a tray in a layer no more than 10-12 cm thick, covered with a clean damp cloth and left to age in the refrigerator for several hours (up to a day). After aging, the meat is kneaded again, adding water and finely chopped onion, and formed into meatballs weighing 53 g. The meatballs are placed on a pre-greased, highly heated grill and cooked evenly on both sides. They are served immediately after baking with side dishes and salads suitable for the respective diets.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Grilled meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned of skins and tendons, cut into pieces and salted, then ground in a meat grinder with a grate diameter of 3-4 mm, kneaded and placed in a tray in a layer no more than 10-12 cm thick, covered with a clean damp cloth and left to age in the refrigerator for several hours (up to a day). After aging, the meat is kneaded again, adding water and finely chopped onion, and formed into meatballs weighing 53 g. The meatballs are placed on a pre-greased, highly heated grill and cooked evenly on both sides. They are served immediately after baking with side dishes and salads suitable for the respective diets.
Note: For diets No. 8 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Grilled meatballs

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and tendons, cut into pieces and ground, salted, mixed with a little water and finely chopped parsley and left for about 1 hour in the cold. From the flour, eggs, a little salt and water, a hard dough is kneaded, from which, after aging for about 1/2 hour, crusts with a thickness of about 2 mm are rolled out. Circles are cut out of the skins with a wine glass. Place a mound of the ground meat in the middle of each circle. The circles with the filling are folded in half and their edges are pressed with a fork or with your fingers. The pelmeni, shaped like crescents, are left in the cold. Immediately before serving, they are placed in a wide vessel with boiling, slightly salted water and cooked over low heat until they float to the surface. Take them out with a slotted spoon and serve immediately, doused with cream or butter melted in a water bath.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Dumplings

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is deboned and cleaned of membranes and sinews, washed and cut into pieces, placed in warm water, salted and boiled over low heat together with the cleaned and washed carrots, then ground and mixed with finely chopped boiled carrots and parsley, pre-cooked rice, lightly stewed finely chopped onions and a small amount of butter. Pancake dough is prepared from flour, milk and eggs. Thin pancakes are fried, in the middle of which the prepared filling is placed. They are rolled up or folded like an envelope. Place them in an oiled pan, brush with the remaining oil and bake in a moderate oven. They are served warm with a salad according to the season and dietary requirements.
Note: For diets No. 7, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Pancakes with beef

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc: The potatoes are washed, peeled and rinsed, poured with slightly salted water (to cover them) and boiled in a pot with a lid. They are drained (if any decoction remains, it is used to prepare soups or second dishes) and pureed while still hot. Boiling milk and butter are added, then the puree is beaten with a wire until it becomes a homogeneous mass. It is served warm.
title: Mashed potatoes

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The cleaned, washed and boiled potatoes and carrots are mashed together while they are still warm. Add the hot milk and fresh butter. The puree is beaten with a wire or a mixer until it becomes a uniform pink mass.
Note:
For diet No. 6, the puree can be prepared without salt and fat. For diets No. 7, 10, the puree is not salted. For diet No. 4, the puree can be prepared without fresh milk.
title: Mashed potatoes and carrots

author: Reneta Ivanova
otherInfo: Garnish a—steamed carrots or potatoes with butter
preparationDesc: The well-cleaned and washed fish is cut into portions 5-7 cm long and 1-2 cm wide, which are dipped in the breading mixture and fried in the heated fat (oil bath) until golden. They are served without or with a side dish of potatoes with butter or stewed carrots, a slice of lemon and a sprig of parsley. The breading mixture or paste, also called breading, is made by beating the egg whites together with the sugar AND adding them to the separately beaten yolks, then gradually adding the flour, beer (or water) and salt.
title: Eagle fish

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
Cauliflower and potatoes are cleaned and washed, boiled together in slightly salted water, drained and pureed. Add the hot milk and fresh butter. Stir the prepared puree and serve immediately.
Note:
For diet No. 6, the puree can be prepared without salt and fat. For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the puree is not salted.
title: Cauliflower and potato puree

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
Boneless and skinless fillets are removed from the fish, covered with water (no more than 1 cm above their surface) and boiled over low heat together with 1/2 of the vegetables (the remaining 1/2 is used to decorate the dish), well washed and finely chopped. After cooking, the fish fillets are arranged in the jelling vessel and decorated with the vegetables and parsley set aside for this purpose. Part of the decoction is diluted with a little water and the gelatin is dissolved in it. The egg white is beaten and
add to the rest of the decoction, which is allowed to boil, then withdraw to a low heat, strain through cheesecloth, mix with the dissolved gelatin and pour over the fish. The prepared dish is left in the refrigerator to gel.
title: Jellied fish

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:
The meat is cleaned of skins and sinews, cut into pieces, salted and ground in a meat grinder with a diameter of 3-4 mm grate holes, then kneaded, spread in a tray or other shallow container in a layer 10-12 cm thick and left to age in the refrigerator for several hours (up to a day). After that, it is kneaded well again, adding the fat and water and forming into kebabs (2 pieces per portion weighing 50 g). The kebabs are arranged on a previously greased and heated grill without touching each other, and are grilled evenly on all sides, carefully turning with a rolling pin. Baked kebabs should be juicy, but not raw. Immediately after baking, they are served with a variety of side dishes and salads according to the requirements of the respective diets.
Note: For diets No. 7, 8, 10, the dish is prepared without salt.
title: Grilled beef kebabs

Pancake dough is prepared from flour, milk and eggs. Thin pancakes are fried, in the middle of which the prepared filling is placed. They are rolled up or folded like an envelope. Place them in an oiled pan, brush with the remaining oil and bake in a moderate oven. They are served warm with a salad according to the season and dietary requirements.

The finished pudding is served immediately after baking.

The mixture is acidified with lemon juice, poured into a suitable container or individual bowl and left to cool. The finished pacha is served with a slice of lemon and a salad suitable for the respective diet.

title: Veal pacha

author: Rihanna Angelova
preparationDesc:

From the flour, eggs, a little salt and water, a hard dough is kneaded, from which, after aging for about 1/2 hour, crusts with a thickness of about 2 mm are rolled out. Circles are cut out of the skins with a wine glass. Place a mound of the ground meat in the middle of each circle. The circles with the filling are folded in half and their edges are pressed with a fork or with your fingers. The pelmeni, shaped like crescents, are left in the cold. Immediately before serving, they are placed in a wide vessel with boiling, slightly salted water and cooked over low heat until they float to the surface. Take them out with a slotted spoon and serve immediately, doused with cream or butter melted in a water bath.
Note: For diets No. 7 and 10, the dish is prepared without salt.

title: Toast with ham and cheese
author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
The shaped bread slices are lightly toasted and spread with butter. Place a piece of the ham on them (the edges of the bread are left 10 - 15 mm uncovered), a circle of pineapple heated in its own sauce and a thin
a slice of cheese to cover the pineapple and most of the ham. The toasts formed in this way are placed in a preheated oven or an electric grill with infrared rays and baked until pink.
They are served immediately.

title: Czech toast
author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: On the lightly toasted slices of bread, smeared with some of the butter mixed with the mustard, place an even thin piece of the ham. A thin piece of cheese is placed on it. The toasts prepared in this way are baked in a device with top heating or with infrared rays until the cheese turns red.

author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc: Cut the ham into small cubes. The eggs are fried lightly in front of the eyes. Sliced ​​bread is toasted, buttered and sliced ​​ham is placed on top. One egg is placed on it. Toast lightly in an oven with top heating or an infrared grill.

title: Potato croquettes
author: Reneta Ivanova

ingredients.text: Spice - black pepper (Piper nigrum L.) corns
ingredients.food: Spice - black pepper (Piper nigrum L.) corns

preparationDesc:
Potatoes are boiled in slightly salted water, peeled and mashed. A thick béchamel sauce is prepared from half of the flour. The onion is stewed with some of the fat. The products are mixed and the grated cheese, melted butter, raw egg yolks and spices are added to them. Croquettes of suitable shapes are made from the resulting dough - balls, carrots, fruits, etc. They are breaded in flour, slightly beaten egg white and breadcrumbs and fried in the hot oven
fat (frying). They are served with a side dish.

title: Spinach croquettes
author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
Spinach is blanched in salted boiling water, drained and chopped or ground. Bechamel sauce prepared by frying 1/4 of the flour and milk, grated cheese, half of the eggs, melted butter, part of the breadcrumbs and spices are added to it. From this mixture, croquettes are made, which are breaded in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat (frying).
They are served with a side dish.

title: Cauliflower croquettes
author: Reneta Ivanova
preparationDesc:
Cauliflower florets are boiled in salted water, drained and finely chopped. Potatoes are boiled in slightly salted water, peeled and mashed. The products are mixed and added to them sequentially
part of the beaten eggs, grated cheese and spices. After kneading the mixture, croquettes are formed, which are breaded in flour, eggs and breadcrumbs and fried in hot fat. Drizzle with cow butter and serve with a side dish.

title: Oatmeal with chia
author: Yanko Petrov
preparationDesc: Overnight oats are one of the easiest and most practical options for a healthy breakfast. To prepare it, put 50 g of oatmeal in a jar or bowl and add about 200 ml of milk (can also be vegetable). Optionally add 10g of chia for more nutrients and better texture. Stir the mixture well, close the container and leave it in the refrigerator for a minimum of 4 hours, preferably overnight. During this time, the oats will absorb the liquid and soften without the need for cooking. In the morning, you can add fresh fruit, a little honey, nuts or peanut butter for flavor. Breakfast is ready immediately and you can even take it on the go.

author: Yanko Petrov
preparationDesc: Heat a pan with a little oil or ghee. Add 40-50g of spinach and sauté for 1-2 minutes until soft. Beat 2 eggs and season them with a pinch of salt and some black pepper. Pour the eggs over the spinach and cook over medium heat until the omelet is set. Fold and serve immediately.

Peeled and washed potatoes are cut into large cubes (slices) and boiled in salted water until soft. They drain from the water.

When serving, they are covered with the sauce and sprinkled with ground black pepper and finely chopped parsley.

The finished sauce is added to the potatoes. The dish is served sprinkled with finely chopped parsley.

title: Ripe bean stew with sauerkraut
author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Cleaned and washed beans are soaked in cold water for 5-6 hours, then rinsed, poured with cold water and boiled at a low boil until soft. Add the sunflower oil and finely chopped onion. At the same time, the chopped cabbage is stewed in lard until soft, colored with red pepper and mixed with the cooked beans. The dish is poured into a tray, seasoned with jozhena, stirred and heated at a moderate temperature or baked in an oven.

title: Green Bean Stew
author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: The green beans, cleaned of stalks, tips, threads and washed, are stewed in part of the fat, adding a little water and salt. In the remaining fat, sauté the finely chopped onion, add the tomato puree diluted with a little water, flour and red pepper. Lightly fry the flour and add the stewed green beans until soft. Pour broth or warm water over the dish and stir gently. Arrange the sliced ​​red tomatoes on top. The dish is baked in the oven at a moderate temperature for about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and serve with yogurt.

title: Pea stew

preparationDesc: Boil the shelled peas in a small amount of water at a gentle boil until soft. Red pepper is also added. The stewed vegetables are mixed with the boiled peas and the remaining finely chopped tomatoes. title: Okra stew
author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Okra is cleaned from the stalks without touching the cups to keep it whole during cooking. So that it does not leak its slimy juice, it is soaked in water with a little vinegar and salt. The onion, cut into thin strips, is stewed in the fat, some of the finely chopped tomatoes or diluted tomato puree, flour and red pepper are added. Pour some warm water. Add the okra, drained from the water in which it was soaked. Stir gently and cook at a gentle boil. Ten minutes before the heating is stopped, salt is added, the remaining tomatoes, chopped, and the lemon, peeled and cut into thin slices, are added. Sprinkle with finely chopped parsley.

title: Minced pork roll with mushrooms and ham
author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: From the minced meat, finely chopped onions and parsley, soaked in fresh milk or water and squeezed bread, eggs, ground black pepper and salt to taste, a mixture is prepared as for meatballs, which remains in the refrigerator for about 40 minutes. After that, the mixture is spread on a wet cloth in a layer in the shape of a rectangle about 2 cm thick. On top, the mushrooms cut into strips and stewed in oil, pickles and onions, as well as the finely chopped hard-boiled eggs are spread in an even layer. With the help of the cloth, the mixture with the stuffing is wrapped into a roll, which is pressed along the length and at the ends so that the stuffing does not fall out. Place the roll in an oiled pan, brush with beaten egg on top and sides, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and grated cheese, pour over the fat, prick in several places with a fork and bake in the oven until golden brown. The finished roll is cut into slices.

title: Warmed with cheese
subtitle: Inova Living
author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc:

salted water until softened, then mix with 2/3 of the grated
cheese, 2/3 of the previously prepared béchamel sauce, small
chopped parsley and salt. Fill a bowl with the prepared mixture or
heaped tablespoon, pre-greased with fat and sprinkled with

cheese. The dish is baked until it turns red. Served with salad
according to the season.

author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc: Cleaned and washed carrots and celery are cut into pieces and stewed in the fat and a little water. The green beans and cabbage, the peas, the potatoes and the courgettes and some of the tomatoes are added successively and stewed. Finally, lightly boiled rice is added. author: Maria Dimova

title: Moussaka through onions
author: Maria Dimova
preparationDesc:
Cleaned and washed leeks are cut into small pieces and stewed in fat and a little water until soft. Add the rice, some of the pureed tomatoes and the spices. Add a little hot water and boil the mixture for about 5 minutes, then pour it into a pan. Arrange the remaining sliced ​​tomatoes on top. The moussaka is baked in a moderate oven, covered with béchamel sauce and baked again.
Bechamel sauce is prepared by diluting toasted flour with boiling milk and stirring continuously until thickened. After removing it from the fire, add the beaten eggs and salt.
